| | | | | |
$40 billion in income just left blue states. And one governor went on camera and used the word "captives" to describe the people who used to stay. Then Iran proved exactly how far their missiles can reach — and it's further than most people thought.
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=d2c1834ea8&e=567664f14c)
| |
🔥 **$40 BILLION FLEES BLUE STATES — HOCHUL SAYS THE QUIET PART OUT LOUD**
IRS data just dropped. Red states gained $37.2 billion. Blue states lost $40 billion.
Then New York's governor called her wealthy residents "captives" — on camera. Her word, not ours.
We show you one graph — NM vs Arizona, same population in 1950 — that tells you everything about what bad governance does over 75 years. When you see where we are now, something clicks.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=477c8bfe74&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
🚨 **IRAN FIRES AT DIEGO GARCIA — 2,500 MILES AWAY. TRUMP WARNED US.**
Two missiles. Neither hit. One failed mid-flight. One was intercepted.
But the range changes everything. European capitals are now within reach. Iran swore they'd limited themselves. They lied.
We play Trump's State of the Union clip where he drops the breadcrumb. When you hear what Mike Waltz says about how Iran hid the technology, you'll understand why we went in when we did.

🛡️ **DRONES SWARM NUCLEAR BOMBER BASE FOR A FULL WEEK — JAMMING FAILS**
Multiple waves. 12-15 drones per night. Over Barksdale Air Force Base — home of our B-52 nuclear bombers.
The military's jamming technology didn't work. Nobody can explain who's behind it. That should terrify you.

Peter,

I’ve now heard Michele Tafoya say it four different times in front of audiences:

_“I don’t do Republican on Republican violence.”_

Then, in the very next breath, she says she supports President Trump.

Think about that.

**If it weren’t for “Republican on Republican violence,” Donald Trump never would have become President. Not in 2016. Not in 2024.**

President Trump had to take on the Republican Establishment before he could take on the Democrats.

_He called out the swamp in both parties.
He exposed the fake conservatives.
He forced the country to confront the corruption in Washington.

_ That’s exactly why the establishment hates him.

And now we’re supposed to believe that the path forward is silence?

_Not criticism?
Not confrontation?
Not calling out politicians who betray the American people?

_ **That’s not leadership.

_That’s surrender._**

Let’s not forget—Michele Tafoya begged President Trump not to run in 2024. Why?

Because she didn’t like the “Republican on Republican violence.”

_While the Biden regime was destroying the country...
While the border was collapsing...
While inflation crushed American families..._

The consultant class wanted Trump to stay home.

Now, suddenly, they want to wave the MAGA flag.

It’s incoherent. And frankly, it’s dishonest.

**These are the same circles of Republicans who won’t pass the SAVE Act.
The same political class that talks about election integrity during campaigns — and then refuses to act when it actually matters.**

And that kind of cowardice should disqualify a candidate immediately.

**Because if you’re not willing to call people out inside your own party, you’re not ready to walk into a U.S. Senate filled with traitors, bureaucrats, and Republicans who oppose President Trump for all the wrong reasons.**

**The cost of cowardice could be the end of the American republic itself.**

Minnesota has a bad habit of letting anyone yank our chain — as long as they promise to do it politely.

Nice speeches.
Nice consultants.
Nice puppets.

Enough.

[**_Are you tired of having your chain pulled, America?_**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=cb9ea93754dc49c7b4d186d949e2154f&_e=hJ7lLvl1bnqsbGZP5K30jC7peUL_5xa7piYZRVi7VVQR_rijg46eoQHC4rfCgBhqdiogwUOPO31yA18pD3mGW9WGTRWjPaYXfQzcRn7aYIFIihMF6yvKUD6CgxZOWgrE0K8fbKGxDXOymAfaQTeKTzUCbbHKcT0pcHN73h1KHiMkzaKOfwfu9gk7LQZblsgRx5cCMGKyP7FkmjsIYpsIyyo-1dVbBzI61xHRG9qhCL2qUwo2SJsK1ygm50EuDm6cJwXADuMU6PzKxl4mHMPsgWM9lVOhSu__sYnTczZhuA81QkigJI1PHsYmLwU4yGR7m3cQW-TkmvE3u0eaPz_ifLrT3H92YmW_d3-7sCfWM8rxVnzic_IiQsK5Y3iEbPzseoI3O8Hq9qjHuiXb9633edRIUPzwEE7eMDYgQv2HoapJjiDhZhAYrNu87l_DbJt0vy2TIBXsiQz5azheCS__dI2RLFtlNyW43WX-FUrXu8NZ2Jhg6mc-WnOoGN0URhmuuHPp4kk2koV7JxjWc9y2a9z2PhFEy0vjF1AcZzsW9UDjJtd7JVdiFdFE3rRX2YBq)

Because the only way this changes is if we stop electing prototypes and start electing real candidates who tell the truth.

**That’s exactly why I’m in this race.**

They have the donors.

The fossil fuel industry says “ Jump ,” and Trump asks, “ How high? ”
Today, I filed my 65th lawsuit against the Trump administration to stop an illegal order that an oil company is using to restart the flow of oil pipelines along California’s coast.
If that’s all you need to hear, join our fight today with a contribution of any amount. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
These are the same pipelines tied to the Refugio oil spill — one of the worst environmental disasters our state has seen in decades. After that spill, courts put strict safeguards in place to protect our communities, our coastline, and our public health.
Now, the Trump administration is trying to override those protections so a private company can restart operations and turn a profit.
They’re trying to ignore state law, override court orders, and sidestep a federal court-approved consent decree. That’s not how the law works, and it’s why we’re taking them to court.
Our lawsuit makes clear that this order violates the Administrative Procedure Act, exceeds authority under the Defense Production Act, infringes on California’s rights under the Tenth Amendment, and violates the Constitutional Separation of Powers.
But this case is also about more than legal arguments. It’s about whether oil industry interests get to dictate what happens to our coast — and of course, whether the Trump administration gets to act outside and above the law.
I won’t just stand by and watch all that happen, so we’re fighting back.
If you’re with me, I’m asking you to support our work today. Will you contribute before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline? You can give at this link: secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]

name: Eric Metaxas
subject: Imagine this, it's horrifying.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Save the Persecuted Christians
body:
The threat is real. Persecution that starts overseas doesn't always stay there.

| | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvtg5kgo7fcc0am3hjgrqphbgs816csfu9ia2jrg_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cpimcor2cdh2bs)
---
Dear Faithful Friend, **Imagine this:** A man steps outside his own home in a quiet neighborhood. Suddenly, violence erupts, his kneecap shattered in a brutal attack. His car torched. His family terrorized for years, children taunted with slurs in the streets, living under police protection for nearly a decade. This isn't a scene from some distant war zone. **This happened in Bradford, England – to Nissar Hussain.** **His only "crime"? Leaving Islam and embracing Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior.** For 17 years, Nissar endured relentless persecution from his former community. The Church of England? _**SILENT.**_ Not one bishop stood with him or his family. **But Save the Persecuted Christians, where I’m proud to serve as a board member, refused to stand by. We brought Nissar here to the U.S. to help him share his story, and he is now fighting back boldly – in part by pursuing a groundbreaking legal case against 11 countries that still mandate death for apostasy. ** [**Your support has amplified his voice and his mission to expose this evil.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjs0l68acohdqtov8l74gc3q3ks4gfdjq6mjikao_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cpimcor2cdh2bs) Nissar's story is heartbreaking, but it's not isolated. Over 380 million Christians face severe persecution globally, and the numbers are growing. _**In Iran, 254 believers were arrested**_ in 2025 alone for simply practicing their faith, escalating further amid the regime's war on Christians. _**In Nigeria, thousands have been slaughtered**_ by Islamist militants: entire villages massacred, girls held captive for years, all because they refused to deny Christ. _**In Pakistan, blasphemy laws **_are twisted to destroy Christian lives. _**In North Korea, owning a Bible**_ can mean a lifetime in a labor camp. **It is for all of these reasons that Save the Persecuted Christians is relentlessly educating Americans and rallying the faithful to recognize the threat before it takes deeper root here.** A powerful example: Our ongoing education and advocacy efforts helped fuel the overwhelming success on March 3, when **95% of Texas Republican primary voters stood up and voted to ban Sharia law** – sending a clear, faithful message: We will not let this ideology gain a foothold in America and threaten our freedoms or our persecuted brothers and sisters in Christ. **The threat is real.** _Persecution that starts overseas doesn't always stay there._ We must be extra vigilant, and **we need your help right now** to keep pushing back. [**Q1 ends at midnight on March 31, and we’ve set a goal of 1,000 individual donations from believers across America to sustain this vital work. Will you be one of them today?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkmb9aps2m60h95gf4cnm9rsnl9eha7d9ojor5n0_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cpimcor2cdh2bs)

Your gift, especially a monthly commitment through The Defenders Guild, multiplies our impact and sustains the fight against this growing evil. [**Click here to give and carry the burden with us.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zn09226lpdl57op15kdger83acqjc0v273bi33g8_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cpimcor2cdh2bs) [**From media campaigns to conferences and everything in between, I’ve seen firsthand how effectively and tirelessly Save the Persecuted Christians guides a coalition of 200+ leaders in order to expose evil and rally the Church – and any support you can offer is well-placed.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsrbeistbesu70uhvprsdp094t1vd5m7vea3em2g_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cpimcor2cdh2bs) **Paul wrote in Galatians 6:2, **_**“Carry each other’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.”**_ **That is our mandate as the Body of Christ.** The Church must rise in one spirit, refusing silence in the face of darkness. His family terrorized for years, children taunted with slurs in the streets, living under police protection for nearly a decade. This isn't a scene from some distant war zone. This happened in Bradford, England – to Nissar Hussain. His only "crime"? Leaving Islam and embracing Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior. For 17 years, Nissar endured relentless persecution from his former community. The Church of England? SILENT. Not one bishop stood with him or his family. But Save the Persecuted Christians, where I’m proud to serve as a board member, refused to stand by. We brought Nissar here to the U.S. to help him share his story, and he is now fighting back boldly – in part by pursuing a groundbreaking legal case against 11 countries that still mandate death for apostasy. Nissar's story is heartbreaking, but it's not isolated. Over 380 million Christians face severe persecution globally, and the numbers are growing. In Iran, 254 believers were arrested in 2025 alone for simply practicing their faith, escalating further amid the regime's war on Christians. In Nigeria, thousands have been slaughtered by Islamist militants: entire villages massacred, girls held captive for years, all because they refused to deny Christ. In Pakistan, blasphemy laws are twisted to destroy Christian lives. In North Korea, owning a Bible can mean a lifetime in a labor camp. It is for all of these reasons that Save the Persecuted Christians is relentlessly educating Americans and rallying the faithful to recognize the threat before it takes deeper root here. A powerful example: Our ongoing education and advocacy efforts helped fuel the overwhelming success on March 3, when 95% of Texas Republican primary voters stood up and voted to ban Sharia law – sending a clear, faithful message: We will not let this ideology gain a foothold in America and threaten our freedoms or our persecuted brothers and sisters in Christ. The threat is real. Persecution that starts overseas doesn't always stay there. We must be extra vigilant, and we need your help right now to keep pushing back. Your gift, especially a monthly commitment through The Defenders Guild, multiplies our impact and sustains the fight against this growing evil. Paul wrote in Galatians 6:2, “Carry each other’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.” That is our mandate as the Body of Christ. The Church must rise in one spirit, refusing silence in the face of darkness. Thank you for your faithfulness and courage in this hour. Dear Faithful Friend, **Imagine this:** A man steps outside his own home in a quiet neighborhood. Suddenly, violence erupts, his kneecap shattered in a brutal attack. His car torched. His family terrorized for years, children taunted with slurs in the streets, living under police protection for nearly a decade. This isn't a scene from some distant war zone. **This happened in Bradford, England – to Nissar Hussain.** **His only "crime"? Leaving Islam and embracing Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior.** For 17 years, Nissar endured relentless persecution from his former community. The Church of England? _**SILENT.**_ Not one bishop stood with him or his family. **But Save the Persecuted Christians, where I’m proud to serve as a board member, refused to stand by. We brought Nissar here to the U.S. to help him share his story, and he is now fighting back boldly – in part by pursuing a groundbreaking legal case against 11 countries that still mandate death for apostasy. ** [**Your support has amplified his voice and his mission to expose this evil.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkL2K3DAUhZ9G7mT0F3mmUBGyDKTYlElpNNId64ItOVfXDvv2wYE8wHanOBy-8_16n98jrliXH3GDkE6cqc-4xQUrcMGO3EsjwtcH1mU2yniprDTuqukhh5S9NQMEPU3Ourue_FCCu-lkozHKW-1vd-Uz2Ph8Zn3_8jJGPQcM15KyxmnlvLajnXKebtrnW4x361_CqWPPkaGPqdUOdEbGE7DWdqVWx9S2YQ2Fee_CfhXmIcwjtxoZxh5P4AI7UId0MORUCDtjrH1stAjzSJHoQ0JMRTYuQF0-D8pQu_yt5XWY513ubRf2cfA2cxL27dvP7_I_tTCeIB1EWBdh35gOGCjk_Q-uK3Y_CaeWLeL6j5I_rfUM5m8AAAD__w7giGQ) Nissar's story is heartbreaking, but it's not isolated. [**Q1 ends at midnight on March 31, and we’ve set a goal of 1,000 individual donations from believers across America to sustain this vital work. ## ICE Deployed to Hobby, Bush Airports
ICE agents [have been deployed](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuupDAQAE9jsh75B4aAYBOyt-mGyGP3QEvGRnbz3nD71ewVNi6pVKo_X-uXp0R5--0PnPn9KmvGn5aQGet6lytv2Djs_jidvH2NL8IUt1VLPYA0oO0aPaV7tV2cnzJOqsNZOWdNL-Wkun2W6jXGUappMm7qx2cY3OjDpKyyOoYxdDR_ZNJoq5RURj1MGHDohzBIH2OPUliJkbjUB-_I-Pbtle7yjfURytGleWc-mzC_hF6EXvwzKPMhQi9naSz0Qg0oIIRyUN5gL1fjksFTPUvlBn7DzA3wfWJgjKAshHJlrjccJUd_Qyp5A24eEmVsEEpmyhcC-V3oRY2uN9o5oZeuzvH8oZSoDU5YuR2e0r9M_r-537P-GwAA__8_K45o) to Houston's Hobby Airport and George Bush Intercontinental Airport to free up TSA agents for the security screening process amid an ongoing partial government shutdown that has caused hundreds of the agency's employees to quit or call in sick. The two major hubs are among the 14 or more airports across the country where ICE has been spotted assisting TSA. Federal officials haven't specified where ICE officers would be deployed due to security concerns. Last Saturday, 11.5% of TSA's 60,000 or so officers didn't show up for work, the highest nationwide absence rate recorded since the shutdown started on Feb. 14. On Saturday, 42.4% of TSA officers assigned to Bush missed work, while 47.4% assigned to Hobby [called out](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuO5CAUAE-DM1rwDNgEDjZxNptuaPF5ttHQ0ILX4_HtV7NX2LikUqn-fGwfLuVUjt_uiQt973UrePWMRNi2u77LgZ3C6Z6vSdyuxT1hjscGAgwXIwe1RZfyvakhLl5EKwdc5DSpUQth5XAu3lk9B70rbSyAn3WYtYXZBVAhTFYNafmRiRGUlEKO8jEGg0abYISLUaNgSmBMVNuDTiT8dn3Pd_3C9gj1OeTlJHp1Nv5isDJYr-t6fJ71_QMZrK5RChkZrP0uMQVHqRYGawjEqbnwmcrBYE0BuTuwUOdnfXeqhbvUXrUR9-9-8rN6fzNYYdbc2t3EPWouvHdc7VryGWzkICSO3o7CWBjaEl9Xyjl1MzEljqdL-V8v_d_lrwX-BgAA__-mKY9P). Peter,
Last summer, the architects of Project 2025 gathered in the White House, presenting a plan that they thought would lock in an unbreachable House GOP majority for decades.
The plan hinged on Democrats self-destructing and failing to mount an effective, unified resistance against MAGA's relentless onslaught of red states one by one swiftly redrawing their congressional districts and eliminating as many Dem-held blue seats as they could.
The plan was working--until people like you and thousands of others demanded that Democrats stand up and fight back.
Colorado Draws The Line heeded that call. Together, we have completely changed the narrative from one where Trump wins to now: the redistricting wars could now become a net positive Democratic advantage.

### Special Event: "Remember the Ladies" in D.C.
---
| | 250 years ago, in a letter that would echo through history, Abigail Adams made a simple but powerful request to her husband, President John Adams: “Remember the ladies”. On March 31, exactly 250 years from the day Abigail penned those words, Moms for America will host the “Remember the Ladies” Tea & Luncheon in Georgetown—honoring the women who helped shape the nation then and those continuing that legacy today. Held at the historic City Tavern—where John Adams attended a reception in 1800 while the White House was under construction, and later decorated under Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis—the luncheon will bring together leaders and mothers to honor the women who built—and still shape—the nation. We would be honored to have you join us for this special occasion on March 31, from 11:00 AM to 1:30 PM, at the historic City Tavern in Washington, DC. Purchase your tickets and sponsorships today.

name: Michael Dukakis
subject: I’ve been doing this a long time

body:
I feel a personal connection to Chris.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260324_1.Xz-Tmb&refcode=em20260324-1&t=1&akid=5741%2E582294%2EbQ3ggR)
Friends,
I’ve spent a long time watching and participating in politics in New England, and one thing I know for sure is that the toughest races are often the most important ones.
**That’s exactly the kind of race Chris Pappas is running in New Hampshire.**
Chris represents one of the most competitive districts in the country — he’s won it four times by doing what strong leaders do: showing up, listening to voters, and focusing on the issues that matter most to working families.
**[But, New Hampshire is not a guaranteed blue state. Chris needs support from all of us if we want to defend this Senate seat for Democrats and push towards retaking the Majority in Washington. Will you step up and chip in $5 to fuel his campaign?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260324_1.Xz-Tmb&refcode=em20260324-1&t=2&akid=5741%2E582294%2EbQ3ggR)**
I also feel a personal connection to Chris. Like me, he’s a proud Greek American who grew up in a family that believed in hard work and public service. Those values are deeply reflected in how Chris approaches his work in Congress.
But anyone who follows politics knows that seats like this are always a top target for Republicans.

body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
You likely have heard about the SAVE America Act —President Trump has said that he will not sign any legislation until this bill passes, despite everything else going on in the world. The Senate is currently debating the bill. The House passed it a few weeks ago. There are a few very important things for you to know:
The bill that the President and Republicans are claiming protects our elections does the opposite: it undermines them. This bill does not protect our elections and I voted against it last month.
The bill is more than merely a solution in search of a problem—it is a problem. To the first point, there is no evidence to suggest that noncitizen voting in federal elections is happening in any significant amount; and certainly not one that requires this kind of response. Second, it is already illegal. We all agree that only American citizens are eligible to vote in federal elections, and that only American citizens should vote in those elections. And that is why that is already the law.
This bill isn’t directed at noncitizens. It’s directed at citizen voters. American citizens. And it’s going to create problems for millions of them.
What does it do? The SAVE America Act , or SAVE Act , adds burdensome documentation requirements for every American seeking to register (or re-register) to vote, including those who have moved addresses or changed their names. When registering or re-registering to vote, Americans would have to provide documents proving their citizenship, like a passport or birth certificate, shifting the responsibility to verify a voter’s eligibility and citizenship status from the government and election officials onto individual American citizens.
If enacted, the SAVE America Act would:
* Implement a modern-day Poll Tax by requiring people to pay for passports and regularly renew them in order to register and vote.
*
* Effectively eliminate online, mail-in, and voter registration drives by requiring applicants who register by mail to present proof of citizenship in person.
*
* Impose new red tape on nearly 70 million married women whose birth certificates may not match their current legal names.
*
* Require states to turn over voter rolls to the Trump administration, increasing federal involvement in election systems.
*
* Add new photo ID requirements for voting, creating additional hurdles for some eligible voters.
Rather than addressing real threats to our election security—it instead adds unnecessary requirements that could prevent eligible Americans from participating in our democracy.
At a time when trust in our democratic institutions is being tested, our responsibility should be to strengthen voter participation, not limit it.
I will keep fighting to do that—to protect the right to vote and ensure that people in TX-07 and across the country can make their voices heard at the ballot box.
You can help us educate and mobilize voters ahead of the upcoming election on this and other efforts to undermine our democratic system of government. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260323?refcode=lpfe260323]

# Judge Blocks ACIP Reforms
|
---
|
---
| Last week, U.S. District Court Judge Brian E. Murphy granted the American Academy of Pediatrics' (AAP) petition in **their lawsuit against Secretary Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.** , issuing a preliminary injunction with major impacts. This ruling:

* Reinstates the prior, higher-dose CDC **childhood vaccination schedule** (reversing its January 2026 reduction from covering ~17 diseases to 11, aligning closer to international norms but now blocked).
* Stays all 2025 vaccine-related votes by the **reconstituted ACIP** , including downgrades to flu, COVID-19, hepatitis B, and other recommendations.
* Halts Secretary Kennedy’s appointments of the 13 new ACIP members, **canceling last week's critical meeting**.

That meeting was set to hear from COVID-19 vaccine-injured patients and consider a **new ICD code** to officially track vaccine injuries. **Quick ACIP Primer:** The Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) is the CDC's expert panel guiding U.S. vaccine recommendations and insurance/public coverage. The HHS Secretary, currently RFK Jr., appoints members for their public health expertise. _But the AAP,_**_a paid membership group_** _, lobbied this judge to override that authority and stall MAHA progress. The government plans to appeal, and we're watching closely._ Texas has won more medical liberty victories than most states through years of grassroots work, but **complacency isn't an option**. The pharmaceutical industry and AAP will go to extreme lengths to protect profits, and overturning decades of overreach won't happen quickly. If last week showed us anything, it’s that our **legislative wins are fragile and our state-level activism is more vital **than ever! Even with Kennedy at HHS, Texas political engagement, legislative fights, and local community outreach remain essential. If you've stepped back thinking "RFK’s got this," consider this your reminder: **our freedoms need defending here at home**. _If you haven’t found your role in the movement yet, just reply to this email! We’ll get you plugged in. Every small action builds the movement for vaccine choice!_

**Winning in a swing state isn’t easy, Derek.**
_Not when the other side is throwing everything they’ve got at you._
_Not when President Trump makes you a personal target._
**That’s where things stand here in North Carolina ahead of the midterm elections.**
Our election is one of the most competitive U.S. Senate races anywhere in the country — one that will determine whether or not we can take back the Senate and break the GOP’s one-party hold on Washington.
President Trump and his political allies are targeting me. Far-right PACs and megadonors are lined up to pour hundreds of millions into defeating me. But I know that we can win.
You see, I’ve won some of the most competitive statewide races here in battleground NC. In fact, _I have never lost a race._ Over and over, we’ve won together — and that’s how we’ll win again.

body:
If you are willing to stand with me to help these patriots rebuild their lives, please join me today by donating whatever you can generously afford to help Stand in the Gap today.

[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=05c58268fbbb488eb521a9c18b838db9&_e=gHbQ5mjkAQo0n_wtzDczatTbM5Lcc6ll2paW6ON84inGnBn1yh9DsD9Y7Hoo8pFDf--6WjROHiFNsKALCa7oZh6AY1QeUZmCZPPBdq7fihWPSK0MqucRhvDTQzRSF0LdsVDcFGVBYoA6AW0ppNwj-Q74gKefZvueWrADYkathfdzRvr_8JK1ZzjdmXyNCj3CmZZIhGL44G681IbZDo_8A4n9fA7TEuTyUOOmAjEMMzum-7z7VQRQkbj8dc-_4vitTtbtyxanPnaD8koez0xB466XI6l9MWbZvM8pcuIzM5-F9isBB4rONYwdE8Cslpoa5Ds4LNLNPg6OhjqtCl9CAwX-5aOKdCThPP0O-6E0_D1mR-S1CYLpNNBM9YWly9ZreI-5XKHlor1xoennjYDwDiO0VzbPj4iaR9mmgNmpb07yUUsrddC2ioMyAg-a0PRi7VE9nJhV0MPm_CXuGANZOWb1i4p6uZIvw_5pqy8Jo_N8f4qskBp9O3o8Bz55KEoX_cUDr-FT-4ChOFDawipeIawHuk7S2-7jXN8IKJW8yQ24UGv-_BIgVbCVSs4loqgFeLAIrzaY8NZ3DUN5JbOHXBhqsg3Ep030LeylgDzg-dyNlRujK52MSmYH2Vtmwemo)

Friend,

Five years ago, I gathered with patriots from all corners of America to protest the certification of the 2020 election results.

All we wanted was for President Trump to get a fair shake, for mail-in vote counts to be redone, and to ensure no fraud had taken place. However, President Trump's enemies saw us coming, and they were ready and waiting to pull off perhaps the biggest psy-op America has ever seen.

Capitol Police officers welcomed many J6ers into the building, with some even providing off-the-cuff tours as they ushered protestors through the halls of the Capitol.

All of a sudden, though, things took a very dark turn...
* A Capitol Police officer murdered Ashli Babbitt.
* Overzealous officers assaulted protestors.
* Rosann Boyland was trampled to death in the panic that ensued as the Capitol Police swiftly turned on peaceful protestors.

For many, like myself, this day marked the beginning of a years-long political persecution that tore families apart, devastated finances, and even denied many of us our freedom and our fundamental human rights.

clean_body: If you are willing to stand with me to help these patriots rebuild their lives, please join me today by donating whatever you can generously afford to help Stand in the Gap today. Friend, Five years ago, I gathered with patriots from all corners of America to protest the certification of the 2020 election results. All we wanted was for President Trump to get a fair shake, for mail-in vote counts to be redone, and to ensure no fraud had taken place. However, President Trump's enemies saw us coming, and they were ready and waiting to pull off perhaps the biggest psy-op America has ever seen. Capitol Police officers welcomed many J6ers into the building, with some even providing off-the-cuff tours as they ushered protestors through the halls of the Capitol. All of a sudden, though, things took a very dark turn... A Capitol Police officer murdered Ashli Babbitt. Overzealous officers assaulted protestors. Rosann Boyland was trampled to death in the panic that ensued as the Capitol Police swiftly turned on peaceful protestors. For many, like myself, this day marked the beginning of a years-long political persecution that tore families apart, devastated finances, and even denied many of us our freedom and our fundamental human rights. It also motivated me to start Stand in the Gap -- a commitment to stand in solidarity with and fight for those who are being overlooked or mistreated. Our goal is to provide support and advocacy for those in need, ensuring they aren't left to face their challenges alone. Stand in the Gap originally started to help reunite families with a loved one incarcerated due to J6. Now, our focus is on helping the recently released J6ers navigate the challenging process of re-entry into society after being incarcerated. Surprisingly, there are very few resources for people who are released from prison, particularly if they are conservative, America First activists, or who supported President Trump. These J6ers are our neighbors. They are sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, mothers and fathers. It is up to us to ensure that they have the resources needed to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity. We were founded to "stand in the gap" for those in prison and those navigating life after incarceration. Our mission is to ensure that every J6er receives the help they need to heal - physically, mentally, emotionally, spiritually, and financially - to reintegrate into society. But they need your help to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity. Sincerely, Shane Jenkins Founder and Executive Director of Stand in the Gap P.S. Even with the pardons, you may not realize what life is like for many J6ers... Harassment on social media and in their personal lives Difficulties in finding a job Homelessness Loss of rights like voting or the right to own a firearm Lost time with their families Struggles to return to some semblance of a normal life There are nearly 1,600 Americans who need to rebuild their lives.** That's exactly what Stand in the Gap is helping them do. Stand in the Gap helps ensure that political prisoners have the resources they need to successfully reintegrate into society and return to their normal lives. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

As permitted by law, TPPAC, Inc. maintains a non-contribution account for the purpose of influencing federal, state, and local elections. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, address, occupation, and employer of individuals whose contribution exceeds $200 in an election cycle. For contributions from federal committees, corporations, and labor unions - regardless of contribution amount - federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the committee’s name and address. State and local law may require us to collect and report additional information.

Contributions to this account may be used to influence federal elections by making independent expenditures in support of or in opposition to federal candidates. Additionally, in state and local jurisdictions that permit non-individual type (e.g., corporate) contributions directly to candidates and/or committees, contributions to this account may be used for both independent expenditures and direct contributions to candidates and/or committees, as permitted by state and local law.

Individuals, federal committees, corporations, and labor unions may contribute to TPPAC, Inc.’s non-contribution account without limit. Contributions by national banks, foreign nationals (without lawful permanent resident status), and other foreign entities (e.g., foreign corporations) are prohibited. Contributions to TPPAC, Inc.’s non-contribution account are not tax-deductible for federal income tax purposes.

body:
Time for Change
| | |

| |

|
Dear Friends,
Join us for Voices for Change and Truth, a community town hall featuring two candidates and a conversation about what it will take to create real change.
The truth is that America First candidates can only do so much on their own. Lasting change requires citizens who are informed, engaged, and ready to act in their communities.
This event is about more than hearing from candidates. It is about bringing people together, asking serious questions, and challenging ourselves to step forward as active citizens.
Come hear the candidates, engage the issues, and be part of a movement focused on truth, responsibility, and action.

Two Candidates. One Community. A Call to Action. Royce White & Mike Lindell
Date: Wednesday, April 8th, 2026 Location: Wayzata Central Middle School 305 Vicksburg Ln N, Plymouth, MN 55447 Social Hour: 6:30-7:00 PM Meet the candidates, connect with neighbors, and engage in meaningful conversation. Community Forum: 7:00-9:00 PM
The time for spectatorship is over. Let's step in, get involved, and do the work real change requires.
---
---
| |
---
Royce White U.S. Senate

Mike Lindell MN Governor

Peter,

I’ve won some of the toughest political fights here in North Carolina, but right now, I’m worried.
This is the #1 Senate race in the country, and experts at Politico are saying that Democrats have no chance to take back the Senate without flipping this seat blue.
**That’s why Republicans are doing everything in their power to defeat me:** President Trump has publicly attacked me and endorsed my opponent, a right-wing group has made a seven-figure ad buy against me and JD Vance just came to North Carolina to double down on their lies.
**Unfortunately, their plan is working: A new poll now shows this race is statistically tied.**
**[Every new day brings a new GOP attack, and I cannot face this onslaught alone. I need people like you by my side. Will you chip in $5, or whatever amount you can, to help me flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7313?t=7&akid=783%2E124072%2Elw1HvN)**

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Friends -
First and foremost, I want to thank you for the support you've given me through all of my campaigns.
I am no fan of having to send out these emails and text messages. Sometimes I have a hard time wrapping my head around the idea that people actually contribute in response to them.
But hundreds of thousands of people have -- and there's no telling what the outcome of my previous races may have been if they ignored messages like this.
Today, I am asking you to join them. Here's why:
The outcome of this election will determine whether we are able to put a check on President Trump during the final two years of his term. We have to take back the House and the Senate.
Taking those majorities back will run through Michigan, where we have a Senate seat we must defend and a few key House races we can flip from red to blue. And I am also being asked to travel to help elect Democrats in red and purple places that Donald Trump won, and where I know we can flip.
All that takes resources, so I am asking people who care to step up and help as the election heats up.

These student leaders represent the next generation of Michigan voters who care deeply about the future of our state and the direction of our education system.
I'm also honored to have the support of [State Board of Education Member Nikki Snyder](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SKMKJMHeVG00LCKlNghvbop9PuWuNB5S9wlshZMlSxcfUfNH0UtZ10FN4pIFZDZC5JKkuDjUoyiB_r-NajjHt_ygBNI7GrW1PEUvqgOx36dwQXIgY3FiUn7VbyjxlQ8sk-0F_AU_9AV4p8Wcda6lTmzY8xm61aoZAaQ3ueX4QKVxcQRpeTOAAyJ1rzo9BE5G0a7NrsIDx_n05WFucKHb-A==&c=ogGpx9CtLUBe9S0HST46JrPSySTbboKEo4pIVmR7-yHuLFkt_l1a3w==&ch=NviGV66_d1b4dSCWpYh35ne7Cq7lZU_0gN0m35ES3msvWMUkkMmMWQ==), a proven advocate for students and families who has consistently stood on principle and fought for accountability.
These endorsements matter. They reflect a growing coalition that understands something simple but important: protecting our education system and standing up for students requires more than rhetoric. It requires a commitment to the rule of law, fairness, and doing the job without political agendas.
While others may try to claim this issue as their own, the truth is that Michigan families deserve an Attorney General who will protect their rights, enforce the law, and ensure that every voice is heard.
That is the kind of leadership I will bring to this office.
Thank you for your continued support as we work toward victory this weekend.

Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

subject: We haven't seen your name yet, Peter: Take a stand AGAINST the SAVE Act today »
disclaimer_text: Paid for by State Democrats Committee (StateDemocrats
body:
This is urgent. The Senate is moving fast. We need your support on this before midnight...
#
Peter,
Last week, the U.S. Senate started seriously considering the SAVE Act – a blatant effort to suppress votes ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.
**[If you’re ready to stand up against this legislation now, please sign on to our letter to Congress advocating AGAINST the SAVE Act today »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102310?t=1&akid=10219%2E614464%2EcmdWsc)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME TODAY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102310?t=2&akid=10219%2E614464%2EcmdWsc)**
**Here’s what this legislation aims to do:**
* American citizens would be required to present a birth certificate or passport before casting their vote. _Data shows that about half of American citizens do not have a passport._
* Married women – _or any person who has changed their name from what was originally on their birth certificate_ – would face significant barriers to accessing the ballot box.
* Local election officials, the people in your community who have always been responsible for conducting elections safely and securely, could face serious legal challenges from the Trump administration.

**So let's be clear about what this legislation really is: A coordinated attempt to make it harder for everyday Americans – seniors, women, young people – to exercise their most fundamental right.**
The Senate is moving fast. We need to show Congress that engaged Americans across the country are watching – and that we won't stand for it.
**[Please, add your name to our letter to Congress today »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102310?t=3&akid=10219%2E614464%2EcmdWsc)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME TODAY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102310?t=4&akid=10219%2E614464%2EcmdWsc)**
Thank you for standing with us.
– SDC HQ

To all members of Congress: Today, I am urging you to oppose the SAVE Act. This legislation would require Americans to present a passport or birth certificate to register to vote – a barrier millions of eligible citizens simply cannot clear. Nearly half of Americans don't have a passport. Birth certificates can be difficult to obtain. And anyone who has legally changed their name – including married women – could find themselves locked out of the ballot box entirely. Voter fraud is already illegal. This bill doesn't solve a real problem. It creates new ones – at the expense of seniors, working families, and everyday Americans who have every right to make their voices heard. Please, reject the SAVE Act and defend the voting rights of your constituents. X ____________________ **[ADD YOUR NAME TODAY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102310?t=5&akid=10219%2E614464%2EcmdWsc)**

Peter,
Summer Lee asked a simple question: would Chairman James Comer enforce a subpoena if Attorney General Pam Bondi refused to comply?
That was it. A straightforward question about accountability.
And instead of answering, Comer insulted her and said she was "bitching" and wasting his time.
Let's just call it what it is:
A powerful white man looked at a Black woman doing her job -- demanding answers, pressing for transparency, refusing to be ignored -- and responded with a sexist insult.
It's disgusting. It's disgraceful. And it is exactly the kind of disrespect Black women are expected to absorb every single day.
But Summer did not back down. She called it out. She kept fighting. And she made clear that asking hard questions is not "complaining", it is her job.
[Click here to make a split contribution to Summer Lee and Colorado Draws the Line right now, and show that when powerful men try to belittle Black women for demanding accountability, we fight back.](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0015072JQ_eQ3K7GNX01tc4WEiSEUam90uf1UT03XRY_25YFZA83q6LC4sfOF90Z0lxHJ5_Zstabo4uv-AHtabUQ3LcXxgoazU47Q8QVGZZKnDWd6-ROZF41vGQ_rRrDidRetOvNeRMhkL6aeUL8dBiqcP8awN2Fz00nVfF3xI3KUYnEdy8KkGaauuaxIY9m6uKbn2wzrY-sRqbMT9X4sl3UA==&c=LizuwGtHZiEnrarV7AOQjC7FFy_NXtHgShvAunt1Nuuf8kdyQvmPrQ==&ch=GnvpexmZVgVMD8IFNrUQiS6Bik5GSUKzVYct2mUrtblGKITPjuPLrg==)
This is about a pattern: when powerful people cannot defend their actions, they lash out at the people brave enough to challenge them.
When Black women demand accountability, they get called "angry," "difficult," or worse.
When Summer pushed for the truth about whether this subpoena would actually be enforced, Comer didn't have an answer, so he went for disrespect instead.
That should make every single one of us furious.
Summer is fighting for transparency. She is fighting for accountability. And she is refusing to let powerful men bully their way out of the truth.
[So if you're furious too, don't just sit with it, click here and make a split donation right now to support Summer Lee and Colorado Draws the Line.](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0015072JQ_eQ3K7GNX01tc4WEiSEUam90uf1UT03XRY_25YFZA83q6LC4sfOF90Z0lxHJ5_Zstabo4uv-AHtabUQ3LcXxgoazU47Q8QVGZZKnDWd6-ROZF41vGQ_rRrDidRetOvNeRMhkL6aeUL8dBiqcP8awN2Fz00nVfF3xI3KUYnEdy8KkGaauuaxIY9m6uK9Pwio_b4Kqha6ffYPGyDRw==&c=LizuwGtHZiEnrarV7AOQjC7FFy_NXtHgShvAunt1Nuuf8kdyQvmPrQ==&ch=GnvpexmZVgVMD8IFNrUQiS6Bik5GSUKzVYct2mUrtblGKITPjuPLrg==)

# **Trump administration moves student loans to Treasury in biggest step yet toward shutting down Department of Education**
The Trump administration announced Thursday an interagency agreement **[moving student lending operations from the Department of Education to the Treasury,](https://substack.com/redirect/a51788ca-1027-4ae8-b0ad-c1317abbe68f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** which will "assume operational responsibility for collecting on defaulted Federal student loan debt" in what experts call the biggest step yet toward dissolving the ED.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a51788ca-1027-4ae8-b0ad-c1317abbe68f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The strategy:** Cato Institute's Andrew Gillen said this shift is "significant" because student loans are "the biggest staffing and the biggest budgetary component of the Department of Education," with Undersecretary Nicholas Kent agreeing it's "absolutely the right way to think about it" as "the next and largest step toward winding down the Department of Education."

* **Why it matters:** The move addresses nearly $1.7 trillion in student loan debt, with less than 40% of borrowers arranging repayment plans and almost 25% in default, which the department says will "mitigate the continuing fallout and cost to taxpayers from the Biden Administration's mismanagement." Gillen said shifting these operations will "make it much more feasible to shut down the Department of Education" since "Education's biggest budgetary and staffing requirements will be handled elsewhere."
* **The progress:** Kent said the ED has made "historic progress" by reducing department size "by over 40%" in a year while entering "10 interagency agreements" to show Congress "that the Department of Education does not need to be here for federal grant aid and federal student loans to continue flowing to borrowers."

# **Pilots warned of LaGuardia safety concerns before Air Canada crash that killed 2, hospitalized 41**
Pilots reported **[safety concerns about LaGuardia Airport to aviation officials](https://substack.com/redirect/b1bb63e9-c5e4-4f18-a24e-5b32a86f8b9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** before Sunday's Air Canada crash that killed pilot Antoine Forest and co-pilot Mackenzie Gunther and hospitalized 41, with one pilot warning last summer "on thunderstorm days, LGA is starting to feel like DCA [Reagan Airport] before the accident there"--referring to January's crash that killed 67. The pilot filed a report claiming air traffic controllers didn't provide guidance on aircraft spacing and a runway lighting system that helped prevent ground encounters had been switched off, begging officials "please do something."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b1bb63e9-c5e4-4f18-a24e-5b32a86f8b9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Important context:** The pilot documented an encounter where controllers gave takeoff clearance to a plane on the ground when their aircraft was only 300 feet high on descent, with the departing aircraft appearing to hesitate "because the Captain of that flight was likely the pilot flying, and was in a position to see how close we were to landing." Other pilots reported stop commands issued by LaGuardia ground control just in time to avert disasters, according to CNN.
* **What happened:** The Air Canada plane plowed into a fire truck responding to a ground incident after touching down from Montreal Sunday night, with both vehicles given conflicting clearances. Air traffic controllers frantically urged the truck to stop moments before impact, with the controller saying he "messed up" in released audio. Passenger Brady Sego wrote the pilots "tried to reverse thrust at the last second. Honestly, they likely saved our lives."

#
Peter —
This isn’t a pop quiz, and sorry to any of my former students I scared with that subject line.
But we do have a test in front of us.
Our movement is facing its first big test of the general election in one week, and I need to lean on you for support to make sure we’re successful.
March 31 is the first official FEC fundraising deadline of the general election.
**[If you know why this deadline matters already, please consider making a contribution right now. I cannot overstate how important this deadline is.](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-general-launch.jRB70q&refcode=em260324-1-ak&t=1&akid=519%2E1347274%2Ebt_yLB)**
I know you hear a lot about these FEC deadlines, and I understand if you’re a bit skeptical. Before I ran for U.S. Senate, I thought the attention on these deadlines was a bit hyperbolic.
But the reality is they have a tremendous impact on the narratives around this race. This one will set the tone for the entire general election.
After the deadline, we are legally required to share our fundraising numbers publicly — not just how much we raise but how we’re funding this campaign.
Our goal is to make clear that, even without a dime of corporate PAC money, our movement has the resources because hundreds of thousands of folks like you are chipping in. A strong report proves Texas is in play — and that they cannot ignore our collective power.
If we fall short, the media will say we aren’t competitive because we’re not capable of raising the resources required to run a statewide campaign in Texas. Folks will write off Texas and dramatically undercut our momentum.
Republican super PACs will also be looking at this report for any vulnerabilities. A bad number will incentivize them to spend early. If they think we don’t have the resources to defend ourselves, they could spend millions overnight to try to crush our movement.
**[So please, if you can, make a contribution to our campaign today. I would not ask if your support before this FEC deadline wasn’t tremendously important. This year's Gabrielle Giffords Rising Star Award nominees give us so much hope at a critical moment when Republicans are trying to take this country backwards. name: Alex Vindman
subject: Here, right matters
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maggie for NH
body:
**“Here, right matters.”**

That’s what I said to Congress at an impeachment hearing against the President of the United States. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127951609/609767276/-1370139186?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.03.24_Alex-Vindman-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP-NC_RS-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYTZjYzU5Yy04ZjI3LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gUVCJtrX_ORGBkn9E1dqkEe0kREbmvWHPOL9JG9Lu_Q=) It’s Retired Lieutenant Colonel Alex Vindman. I never intended to be in the national spotlight. I joined the Army and served for 21 years because I wanted to fight and defend the country I love. I could have never expected that it would lead me to testify against the President of the United States.

_That is, until I heard the president try to extort a foreign country into investigating a political rival — a quid pro quo._

I swore an oath to support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic. It was my duty to report the corruption.

Today, we confront one of the most insidious pillars of the MAGA movement: **Controlled Mass Media.** _In a healthy republic, the press is a watchdog. In a regime, it is a lapdog._ Recently, Trump’s Pentagon chief, Pete Hegseth, explicitly attacked CNN for reporting on the reality of the widening war in Iran. His "solution" for a network that dares to speak the truth? _“The sooner [MAGA billionaire] David Ellison takes over that network, the better.”_ This isn't an isolated comment; it's a victory lap. We are witnessing a [coordinated billionaire blitz](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZsC4GjLalp3SAiN6UEaHRjAUWy1_9MHtpKKmjYahv2XRCMpR74Lef8dCWiECOLoxHuif3wPFt6mtS7mxs1RKYsAHb_3AgB6BwDpyGrsTWWgO9jCS59jCLh8YmbEB3yPiSqC-FxyjmprklFpn-lNEhkI-IxIWdNnHLc5odun7p2ax0z0TNrtWYfM7kG0wjkropkfVZS7YUQG4Hy-i26FfIS_gh20zv3vsSszXu-D0LbN_0KCLUxm9_qOiBMgeSnZIye9_pDOK06wHKrRghtlifyNycGRjmGdZakqqc3E3rR_ZtyR8ErZbwLaao5V_3rkFgfW3I3TAHZ4QlfrneDHQV8iUBeeBlNigK8grfA24hLVq/4p7/YyMxM-VjTsWy4gEA4pD-vw/h3/h001.lkV3xcBdtxWP_b9wGd5uQCpSykwxTPN3WqzJN4QNgOo) to seize control of the American narrative. Today, 90% of U.S. media is controlled by just six massive corporations, and that circle is rapidly narrowing into the hands of Trump-friendly billionaires:
* **CNN & CBS:** David Ellison, son of Trump megadonor Larry Ellison, is moving to consolidate both under his control, already installing a pro-Trump editor-in-chief and a "bias ombudsmen" to police coverage.
* **The Washington Post & LA Times:** Owners Jeff Bezos and Patrick Soon-Shiong, both dependent on federal contracts, have already spiked endorsements and gutted newsrooms to avoid Trump’s retaliation.
* **X (formerly Twitter):** Elon Musk has transformed the platform into a far-right echo chamber that amplifies propaganda while throttling traditional journalism.
* **Local Airwaves:** Sinclair and Nexstar are aggressively lobbying the FCC to eliminate ownership caps so they can flood 80% of U.S. households with pro-regime content.

When the national media is sold to the highest bidder or bullied into silence, the truth is the first casualty. **_Local democracies are the final guardrails for our national democracy._**__ **Local Democracy Project recruits and trains candidates for local and state offices who will fight for independent media and stop these billionaire-backed monopolies from stealing our voice.** [**Help us build the local firewall against the 6th sign of fascism. Peter,

I went to SFO yesterday morning, just hours after a mother was detained by ICE in front of her child - in the middle of a public airport, surrounded by travelers.

This was a moment of fear and trauma that no family should ever have to experience.

Standing there yesterday, it was impossible to ignore what this means.

This isn’t an isolated incident. It’s part of a broader escalation - a push to expand ICE activity into airports across the country.

**Spaces that are supposed to be safe, public, and shared are being turned into sites of fear and enforcement.**

**We cannot let that become normal. Now is the time for us to speak up - and speak out.**

body:
#
Peter,
It's on.
**Dark money Super PACs are spending millions of dollars to defeat our grassroots people-backed movement for Congress in PA-03.**
Yes, these are corporate PAC and insider-backed organizations. Yes, they have worked with and received millions from AIPAC, allied donors and organizations. There's no doubt: our opponents have become fully-formed, dark money-backed, establishment politicians. **[Unless you help us now, they will win.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260324-cr.z5_jOQ&refcode=em20260324-37598&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=37598%2E1203867%2ENcuto6)**
Philadelphia has a chance to reset our politics. But the billionaires will spend everything they can to keep status quo, because status quo is how they've made their billions.
_It's up to us to stop them._
**We are coming up fast on our March 31 filing deadline.** We are going to spend our money efficiently and on a cutting-edge grassroots field program that brings a movement into power. We need your help to do that.
**[We know that dark money and corporate PACs are going to spend more than $2 million on TV ads for our opponents. We need you to split a grassroots donation now to make the $25,000 we will need this month to set up our final push for field. Our campaign chooses not to take money from corporate PACs or shady dark money groups, because we know that's how politicians are bought — we choose to be people-powered, and that means it's up to folks like you to help us compete with the billionaires.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260324-cr.z5_jOQ&refcode=em20260324-37598&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=37598%2E1203867%2ENcuto6)**

Our campaign is laser-focused on collecting the volunteers and supporters we will need to win on May 19. We won't be able to without your help.
**We are up against Trump-aligned corporate PAC money. We are tied for first place in polls. Unless people come together and power our movement, fascist oligarchs will spend what it takes to win the bluest Congressional seat in the nation.**
**[Please donate $5 to my campaign and Justice Democrats now to invest in our cutting-edge field program.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260324-cr.z5_jOQ&refcode=em20260324-37598&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=23&akid=37598%2E1203867%2ENcuto6)**
It will take all of us working together to win, and that is the exact reason I have confidence in our chances.
Onward together,
Chris Rabb

subject: Re: Find your local No Kings Rally for Saturday!
body:
Peter,
This Saturday, March 28th, millions of people will be coming together across the country to demand that our leaders stand with communities, not corporate polluters. Will you join us for No Kings National Day of Nonviolent Action? Find an event near you here. [https://www.nokings.org/]
Everyday people should no longer be left to bear the costs of climate disasters, rising energy bills, and polluted air and water, or live in fear and instability.
Find your event [https://www.nokings.org/]
Together,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Britney_signature-removebg-preview.png]
Britney VanCitters (she/her)
OLCV Political & Organizing Director
https://www.nokings.org/ [https://www.nokings.org/]
Peter,
Families across this country are still living with fear and instability, and the climate crisis is getting worse. Masked ICE agents are being sent into our neighborhoods, ripping families apart and terrorizing communities. The cost of living keeps rising, and people can't afford basic needs like healthcare, housing, or groceries, while communities are facing intensifying wildfires, floods, and heat waves.
Instead of confronting the climate crisis and helping communities prepare and recover, this administration continues to hand out giveaways to billionaires and immunity to big oil companies – letting the corporations responsible for climate pollution avoid accountability. Everyday people are left to bear the costs of climate disasters, rising energy bills, and polluted air and water.
This is not the America we were promised. Will you join us on Saturday, March 28th for No Kings National Day of Nonviolent Action? Check here to find an event near you. [https://www.nokings.org/]
Find your event [https://www.nokings.org/]
Across the country, people are coming together in morally grounded, nonviolent direct action to demand a different path forward: one where our leaders stand with communities, not corporate polluters.
We’re showing this president and the world that our country does not belong to greedy billionaires or the fossil fuel companies fueling the climate crisis. It belongs to the people, and to the generations who will inherit the planet we leave behind.
No Thrones. No Crowns. No Kings!
In solidarity,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Sarah%20Signature.png]
Sarah Kline (she/they)
OLCV Communications & Membership Coordinator

Lately, I've been doing some reflecting on my grandfather, President John F. Kennedy, and his legacy of hope.
In my run to fight for NY-12 in Congress, and just as a person, that's what I want to focus on. Hope.
My name is Jack, or John Bouvier Kennedy Schlossberg if you want to know the whole thing.
In high school, I spent hours watching my grandfather's speeches. He taught us all that politics isn't about serving yourself — it's about serving others. When we fight for hope, we're not just doing it for ourselves, we're doing it for each other and the future we all have to share.
I know I have big shoes to fill. In my grandfather's memory, I've led a life of caring about this a lot. I put that care and effort and hope into everything I do.
But this is bigger than me. It's bigger than my family's legacy.
Hope is hard to find in Politics these days, but if we let it die out completely, that's how we really lose. Now cannot be the time to stop caring or turn away. We have to double down in our pursuit of hope.
I really think this election is the one — our last chance to stop Trump and change the direction we're heading in.
I need you to know that I believe we can do it. I believe in hope, and I believe in us. Will you believe with me? [Barlow Logo](https://barlowforwyo.com/)

Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, inf=
ormation and upcoming events.

=E2=80=8A

SHOW UP. DO THE WORK. GET RESULTS.

Hi friends,
After a few days back home taking care of things on the ranch, Kelly and I =
got back out on the road to visit folks across Western Wyoming.
=C2=A0
We spent some time in Jackson before making our way through Star Valley Ran=
ch, Thayne, Alpine, Pinedale, Kemmerer, Evanston, Farson, and Rock Springs.=
Along the way, we had the chance to visit with community members, local le=
aders, and first responders, and hear directly about what=E2=80=99s working=
and where folks see challenges ahead.
=C2=A0
One of the highlights was seeing the student-created mural in Thayne. It=E2=
=80=99s a great reminder of the pride people have in their communities and =
the effort they put into making them strong.
=C2=A0
What stands out most from this week is how consistent the conversations rem=
ain. People care about their communities, their jobs, and the future of Wyo=
ming. They want practical solutions and leadership that understands how thi=
s state actually works. No scare tactics, no endorsement gimmicks. They wan=
t someone who will show up, do the work, and get results.=C2=A0
=C2=A0
Others getting results were our University of Wyoming wrestlers, who=C2=A0
produced a program-best three All-Americans (most since 1996) and totaled a=
program-best 38 points as the NCAA Championships in Cleveland. They finish=
ed 12th in the team standings. Wyoming shows up and competes, and it=E2=80=
=99s great to see that kind of hard work pay off on a national stage. Go, P=
okes!

=C2=A0
Friends, we continue to be grateful for the support we=E2=80=99ve received,=
always. If you=E2=80=99ve been to an event, thank you. If you haven=E2=80=
=99t yet, we hope you=E2=80=99ll come out and join us when we're in your ar=
ea. Bring a neighbor, bring a friend, and take the time to get your questio=
ns answered.
=C2=A0
Wyoming has always been a place built on hard work, common sense, and looki=
ng out for one another. That=E2=80=99s worth protecting, and it=E2=80=99s w=
hat this campaign is about.
=C2=A0
=E2=80=94 Eric

I’m Jennifer: a second-generation nurse, a proud single mom, the daughter of a veteran who grew up in a union home, a native Illinoisan, and the Democratic nominee for Congress in IL-15.

I was born and raised right here in southern Illinois. Like many Americans, I know what it’s like to work night shifts and still come up short on bills. I’ve experienced being on Medicaid, SNAP, and unemployment.

| | | | | This may be the most critical moment you and I have ever faced.

It's Byron Donalds, President Trump's strongest ally, and I'm asking you to pause what you're doing and read this immediately.

Right now, the media, the Democrats, and even weak Republicans are all saying the same thing:

**They claim MAGA will be done by the end of the year.
They claim everything we fought for meant nothing.
They claim passing the SAVE America Act is impossible -- the very bill that would guarantee only U.S. citizens decide American elections.**

They think we've lost our strength.

They think we've lost our fight.

But I vividly remember what President Trump told me after I just spoke with him:

**[KEEP MAGA STRONG.](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/QkSou9FyuwKVckwWDxKZVohOGsJcB5dauDy8IpY1TtOh9E82tcvXpU8SHPHeOC764aO6UVZL9tF6d2-0g-N2ai-XxtMJklkhyxtTaH_vbWMoXpKgUFAORUslLToDAUXpN6r9oUGRgbSfAmMwkf-cVB6OrTrL4Su_FFojUuj5iGhrzyLAL1yTPLcJA_JVcMGWhjurd37eWSuA0qZUlLYKy-i6u5bRzewxMGy4TaKfo59lkOi3ZsHNtmckfdA_NADeGViLHt2lSJv9PJL-aVNuH0WRAioBTL6tSJIRm4xLIW5w7BgcYEjHMpqES9SMDwovMaqquGfRcrR2vZEU9uNcrH9dJ19mhrfvcmokohHl5TbenDfsyDrNRHPK23oHajCVTRi7GMz-KXli08gsGk78Tj082pk6ZVnBQL6EKDtjUxjVyCGQISpXM2r1SQfIvoY77Ww3oEttpIZX6rKC5yfwg_5kJC3k-n8Op-3plYjniUwUqcKuCIzh40RuuO002Z4U6lztzNrUOWbZc5ttvH7dKznvr3k5u-8gHeu2wLzTgasDaH1Bac2dHcDGHNSer15eAuU7rgekZNO5lsa4vCDcUSOtjh_BSDgg8g2iM-Ci0TDIAxflP8Ina8s/pPdFI7AlESA2NJgof1fs0hTohCbZeZbg/19 "KEEP MAGA STRONG.")**

He's given me a **_DIRECT_** task to create the largest MAGA mobilization ever, and I immediately thought of _**YOU**_ being a part of it.

Because when the stakes are highest, we need the strongest patriots like **YOU** , standing with us.

If we're going to restore momentum and pass the SAVE America Act, it will only happen because people like you step forward and make their voice heard.

That's why I'm asking you for just a few seconds of your time to answer a couple of urgent questions.

Stand with us and help me show EVERYONE that MAGA is stronger than ever.

And I've never stopped fighting either.

**That 's why President Trump and I are at the TOP of the Democrats' list to take down**, and if we don't respond with authority right here, right now, I fear what could happen next.

I won't sugarcoat it, Chuck Schumer and his gang of radical Democrats are working overtime to stop us.

_**That 's why the moment to act is right now.**_

I've called on you when it matters most, and I need you now more than ever, because I can't let President Trump, you, or MAGA down.

So please, answer a few CRITICAL questions for me and sign your name below.

Byron

Donald Trump’s weaponization of the Justice Department is just plain wrong.

|

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127965736/609797901/1947108721?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_DOJ_260324_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDI5MzQ0Yi05YTI3LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HJU2wO8g3bxTW3t-C0NsMancNrK9QfBkC7AuE3ddo4A=) The list of Donald Trump’s abuses of power grows every day, Derek.

One of the most disturbing actions taken by this out-of-control president has been his weaponization of the Department of Justice. You see, the DOJ is supposed to be nonpartisan and independent, free from petty, personal grievances or any political agenda. It is supposed to enforce our nation’s laws, not enact the will of a president.

**But over the last few months, Derek, we’ve seen Trump use the Justice Department as his own personal score-settling operation.**

Trump has used the Justice Department to go after his perceived political enemies, including state officials investigating his crimes and members of the Federal Reserve. And, recently, six of my Democratic Congressional colleagues – all veterans who served this nation bravely.

**Donald Trump is using the Justice Department for retribution, not rule of law. It’s dangerous, wrong, and frankly, un-American.**

I’ve been on the front lines of this fight to hold this president accountable. But I can’t do it alone. With Republican majorities in the House and Senate that absolutely _refuse_ to meaningfully stand up to this administration, they prove that we must flip the balance of power in Congress.

That’s why this year’s midterm elections are so critical. This November, we have the chance to flip control of the House and Senate and finally put a check on this president.

[_**And Virginia is at the center of this fight – the path to Democratic control of Congress runs right through the Commonwealth. So, I’m asking: can you pitch in to my campaign today to help Democrats win the midterms and restore integrity, decency, and the rule of law in Washington?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127965741/609797905/1947108721?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_DOJ_260324_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDI5MzQ0Yi05YTI3LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HJU2wO8g3bxTW3t-C0NsMancNrK9QfBkC7AuE3ddo4A=)

The fight continues,

Mark Warner **Before you go:**

We’re asking people like you – who care deeply about our democracy and the future of our country – to join us in our fight to help Democrats win the midterms and bring accountability and transparency to Washington.

[_**Will you contribute today to reelect Mark Warner, support Democrats in races across Virginia, and flip control of Congress?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127965747/609797912/1947108721?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_DOJ_260324_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDI5MzQ0Yi05YTI3LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HJU2wO8g3bxTW3t-C0NsMancNrK9QfBkC7AuE3ddo4A=)**__********[Contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127965752/609797926/1947108721?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_DOJ_260324_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDI5MzQ0Yi05YTI3LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HJU2wO8g3bxTW3t-C0NsMancNrK9QfBkC7AuE3ddo4A=)**********

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. ### The secret to being a successful public servant.
