Hi friends,
I love talking to people, especially Michiganders. I crack open a pop and chat until the cows come home.
But here's a little secret to being an effective politician: _Stop talking._
Truly. Michiganders know what Michigan needs better than anyone. I learned a long time ago that the first step to getting stuff done is always the same: **listen.**
That's why I'm reaching out with a simple request: **[Will you take one minute to fill out my 2026 Priorities Survey? We're collecting 1,000 responses before midnight tomorrow, and I'd be honored to hear from you directly.](https://substack.com/redirect/4e100ab8-34b0-4aa0-9bd3-b515d9fd9ab8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Take the Survey](https://substack.com/redirect/4e100ab8-34b0-4aa0-9bd3-b515d9fd9ab8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Here 's why it matters:**
This is shaping up to be one of the most competitive Senate races in the country. Poll after poll shows I'm neck and neck with MAGA Republican Mike Rogers, and _The New York Times_ even recently named Michigan a key battleground in the fight for Senate control.
The stakes are high. That's why GOP billionaire megadonors are lining up behind Rogers, trying to buy this seat so they can rubber-stamp Trump's chaos agenda in the Senate.
So how do we fight back? **By building a grassroots campaign that listens, learns, and leads - in that order.**
We've already made so much progress:
✅ I introduced the **Stop Trump 's Abuse of Power Act** after Donald Trump abused his power and deployed the military against U.S. citizens.
✅ I led the charge to bring **semiconductor manufacturing back** to Michigan, creating good-paying jobs for our communities.
✅ I introduced the **No Tariffs on Groceries Act** to stop Trump's chaotic price hikes at the checkout line.
✅ I filed articles of impeachment against **RFK Jr.** for putting public health at risk and lying to Congress.
I'm proud of this work. Because it all came from listening to the _real_ concerns of _real_ people - and then taking action to fight for them.
So as we build a winning strategy for what will be a generation-defining election in Michigan, I want to make sure this campaign reflects _your_ priorities.
What's keeping you up at night? What change do you want to see? What matters most to you and your family? How can the government actually help you?
**[Will you please take a minute and let me know? It's a short survey, but it truly helps a ton.](https://substack.com/redirect/4e100ab8-34b0-4aa0-9bd3-b515d9fd9ab8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Take the Survey](https://substack.com/redirect/4e100ab8-34b0-4aa0-9bd3-b515d9fd9ab8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This is your campaign just as much as it's mine. And together, we're going to make history.
I'm so glad you're here.
With grit and gratitude,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/a7a6ebfa-4bc4-4c1c-a465-4965b3056e23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Friend,

**Trump was in Memphis yesterday** to celebrate the Memphis Safe Task Force for allegedly combating crime. He and TN Republicans have been**telling lies about Memphis** because they don’t want you to realize the truth: **they are the reason crime was up in the first place.** **** When the Republican-controlled state legislature passed a law allowing guns to be stored unsafely in cars without consequence, Memphis became **#1 in the nation for guns stolen out of cars** , and Chattanooga ranked #2. This isn’t just a coincidence. Before this law, we had a few hundred gun thefts from cars per year. Following the passage of the Republicans' law, it shot up into the thousands. **Republicans in the state legislature have been clear that they plan to continue doing nothing to address this crisis.** When we tried to put measures on the ballot in Memphis to limit access to weapons of war and keep guns out of the wrong hands, **Speaker Cameron Sexton threatened to withhold Memphis’ sales tax revenue**. Despite this, the measures passed with **80%** support, including NRA cardholders and gun owners. In 2023, in the immediate aftermath of The Covenant School shooting that took the lives of 3 adults and 3 children in a Nashville suburb, Republican Congressman Tim Burchett told reporters,”We’re not going to fix it.” He was telling the truth for once. In response, I launched a free gun lock program, and in just two years, **gun thefts from cars dropped by 25%** , and violent crime also decreased by 25%. This was long before the National Guard ever arrived in Memphis. Still, we see **Trump** , **Governor Bill Lee** , and my opponent, **Senator Marsha Blackburn** , swooping in like vultures to take credit, as if they weren't the architects of this disaster in the first place. **I’m calling bullsh*t.** It's been Democrats like me that have been working tirelessly to protect our communities, despite Republicans’ harmful gun policies. **Republicans do not care about stopping school shootings** , **gun violence,** or **accidental deaths**. Democrats are the ones actually doing the work to make our streets safer. The facts speak for themselves. **6 of the 10 safest states in the U.S. are led by Democratic governors.** Maybe it’s time that Tennessee tries something different.
We can’t do this alone. To continue fighting back against the lies and dangerous policies that put our communities at risk, I need your support. When we tried to put measures on the ballot in Memphis to limit access to weapons of war and keep guns out of the wrong hands, Speaker Cameron Sexton threatened to withhold Memphis’ sales tax revenue. **NEW VIDEO: PRESIDENT TRUMP ENDORSES JULIA LETLOW FOR SENATE** _Trump calls Letlow “a true America First patriot” and says she will be Louisiana’s next U.S. Senator_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — President Donald Trump has released a new video delivering his complete and total endorsement of Congresswoman Julia Letlow for the United States Senate, making it clear that she is the candidate he knows, trusts, and wants to represent Louisiana in Washington.
In the video, President Trump praises Letlow as “very, very special,” calls her “a great congresswoman,” and says she will be Louisiana’s “next United States Senator.” He highlights her record of fighting for border security, tax relief, Louisiana’s oil and gas industry, and the state’s farmers and fishermen, while describing her as “a true America First patriot” who will serve Louisiana “with honor and distinction.”
President Trump closes the video with a direct call to action for Louisiana voters: “Everybody go out and vote and send Julia Letlow to the United States Senate. She will set a new standard. She’s incredible... You have my complete and total endorsement.”
_“President Trump knows this race matters, and I am deeply honored to have his complete and total endorsement,”_**said Congresswoman Julia Letlow.**_“I have been proud to stand with him and fight for the America First agenda, and I will keep working every single day to deliver for the people of Louisiana. This campaign is about making sure our state has a senator who will stand strong for President Trump’s agenda, defend our conservative values, and never waver.”_
The video is the clearest possible reminder of the choice facing Republican voters in this race. Julia Letlow is the Trump-endorsed conservative who will fight for Louisiana and stand with the America First movement in the Senate. Bill Cassidy is the incumbent senator who voted to convict President Trump and lost the trust of Republican voters across the state.

[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/congress_act_insider_trading_032426/?source=em260324-1-90&akid=4098%2E734936%2ELeUkI0)
You’ve probably heard about something like that, in one way or another, since Trump took office.
Insiders making perfectly timed trades before and after Trump raised and lowered tariffs. More stock market trades around contracts awarded to well connected firms. Even betting on how long Karoline Leavitt's White House press briefing will last.
But it’s actually worse than that. It’s people making bets when the lives of American troops are on the line. Bets on oil futures, timelines, and outcomes during Trump’s illegal attack on Venezuela — and now, all that on steroids around the Iran War.
These people aren’t just getting lucky. They’re well connected insiders within the Trump White House, and they have access to the most sensitive information you can imagine. While you are paying higher prices for everything, they are making millions of dollars. While Americans are killed and wounded at war, they are profiting off of their sacrifice.
It turns my stomach, and it’s time we did something about it. Here’s what’s on the table:
First off, we need to make this completely illegal, and impose steep penalties on anyone who does it.
Second, we need to go after everyone — in and out of the Trump administration — who has made massive profits off bets on stocks, commodities, and prediction markets. It’s the absolute pinnacle of grift and corruption, and it’s happening while regular people can’t afford gas, medicine, or food.
[**Please — if you still care about this country and believe we can do better than this — add your name and demand Congress act to stop these corrupt insiders from getting rich while the rest of us go broke.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/congress_act_insider_trading_032426/?source=em260324-1-90&akid=4098%2E734936%2ELeUkI0)

Let’s get these people.
Thanks,
Ruben

"This operation is a clear, devastating, decisive mission: destroy the missile threat, destroy the navy, no nukes." Sec War, Pete Hegseth
The $1.7 billion payment to Iran during the Obama administration was a major controversy involving a settlement of a pre-1979 arms deal dispute, with allegations that it was effectively a ransom payment for American prisoners.
In January 2016, the Obama administration's $1.7 billion cash payment to the Islamic Republic of Iran became one of the most controversial foreign policy transactions in modern U.S. history. The circumstances surrounding the settlement, its relationship to the Iran nuclear deal, and the criticisms that continue to surround it continue to echo today.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.EJXcVPi2tXAYxIgGmdyNDN04_TEpYL7VFjEfbLgdZVU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=192001581)
The payment originated from a long-standing financial dispute dating back to 1979, when the Iranian Revolution overthrew the Shah of Iran. Prior to the revolution, the Shah's government had signed a $400 million contract to purchase American military aircraft and services. Following the hostage crisis and the severing of diplomatic relations, these funds remained frozen in a Treasury Department account.

For over three decades, Iran pursued claims for this money through the Iran-United States Claims Tribunal at The Hague, an arbitration body established as part of the 1981 Algiers Accords. Consequently, the U.S. government faced significant exposure to interest payments, with estimates suggesting the total obligation had grown substantially above the original $400 million principal.

In January 2016, as negotiations over the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA)--commonly known as the Iran nuclear deal--reached their conclusion, the Obama administration announced a settlement of $1.7 billion to resolve this dispute. The administration maintained that this amount reflected both the original $400 million principal and calculated interest accrued over nearly four decades.

The payment was delivered entirely in cash, consisting of various foreign currencies, including euros and Swiss francs. The Treasury Department justified the cash format by noting that sanctions had effectively blocked Iran from accessing the international banking system. According to administration officials, this method was the only viable means of completing the transaction given the constraints of the sanctions regime.

The payment's timing coincided with a prisoner exchange in which four American citizens detained in Iran--Washington Post reporter Jason Rezaian, former Marine Amir Hekmati, pastor Saeed Abedini, and Nosratollah Khosravi-Roodsari--were released. This confluence of events sparked intense criticism from administration opponents.

Critics, including numerous congressional Republicans, characterized the payment as "ransom" for the American detainees, arguing that it incentivized Iran and other hostile nations to seize U.S. citizens as bargaining chips. The Obama administration vigorously disputed this characterization, insisting that the settlement was entirely separate from the prisoner release and had been negotiated through distinct channels.

The controversy surrounding the $1.7 billion payment persists in American political discourse. Supporters argue that the settlement was a financially prudent resolution of a decades-old legal dispute and that the nuclear deal, which the payment facilitated, was essential to preventing Iranian nuclear weapons development. Critics counter that the transaction emboldened Iran's regional aggression, funded terrorism, and set a dangerous precedent for hostage negotiations.

The Biden administration unfroze $6 billion in Iranian funds in September 2023 as part of a prisoner exchange deal.

The money was Iran's own oil revenue that had been frozen in South Korea due to U.S. sanctions. The funds were transferred to Qatar with strict restrictions that they could only be used for "humanitarian purposes" (food, medicine, agricultural goods). In exchange, Iran released five imprisoned American citizens.

Following the Hamas attack on Israel, the U.S. and Qatar blocked Iran's access to this $6 billion. Secretary of State Antony Blinken stated in October 2023 that "Iran has not yet been able to spend a single dollar" of the unfrozen funds. In November 2023, the House passed a resolution to formally block access.

Some sources claim $16 billion was "handed over" to Iran, including the $6 billion from the prisoner swap plus extensions of Trump-era sanctions waivers that allowed Iraq to pay for Iranian electricity.

The Biden administration unfroze $6 billion of Iran's previously frozen assets for a prisoner exchange, but Iran was ultimately blocked from accessing those funds after the October 7 attacks.

Based on available data, Iran has likely spent approximately $25-35 billion total on defense from 2020-2024. Of this, IRGC (including its navy and missile forces) roughly $10-14 billion and a missile programs that estimates suggest anywhere from $500 million to $2 billion annually. All gone.

"The mission of Operation Epic Fury is laser-focused: destroy Iranian offensive missiles, destroy Iranian missile production, destroy their navy and other security infrastructure -- and they will never have nuclear weapons." Sec War Pete Hegseth
The Iranian episode exemplifies the complex intersection of diplomacy, law, and security that characterizes U.S.-Iran relations, and the waste of American money when dealing with a terrorist regime. It remains a flashpoint in debates over the appropriate use of American leverage in State Department negotiations with authoritarian regimes.

Joining me is James Ottar Grundvig is a first generation Norwegian-American, who lives and works in Florida. As an investigative journalist, he covers technology, sustainability, energy and business, and their intersections. James has outmaneuvered mainstream media in breaking stories, from the political red-tape with the BP Oil Spill, to the Zika money grab by the CDC.

James has published dozens of articles in the Huffington Post, the Financial Times Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) magazine, the Epoch Times, Law.com, and GreenMedInfo.com, among other media outlets.

His three published books span a broad range of subjects in the novel "Dolphin Drone" and non-fiction titles "Master Manipulator" and "Breaking Van Gogh." Technology is the common thread that connects the three books. You can find him at <https://substack.com/@battle4cog>

Michaela canvassing with volunteer Nikki Holt in S Knoxville
**I love knocking doors.** It's one of the most direct ways we can encourage voters to get off the sidelines and into the arena. It's a chance to talk about what folks care about, who is running and on what issues, and when and where to cast their vote.
This past Saturday we kicked off canvassing for my campaign. It was a thrill to see two-thirds of volunteers' hands go up when I asked how many had never knocked doors before. That's a good sign, as we'll need about 2,000 volunteers to knock 70,000+ doors over the next seven months. (I hope **[you'll join our volunteer Cavalry](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3a69fd17-51a5-4055-85c5-6c1874cd26f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**, whether that's for door-knocking, phone banking, texting, postcard writing, event wrangling, merchandise sorting, or any of the other dozens of needs we have!)
This Saturday, as I rounded a hill, I saw a man out in his yard with his dog. He wasn't on my list, but that doesn't usually stop me from striking up a conversation. I told him who I was and what I was running for, and he listened politely before telling me, "We don't vote. Never have."
"Why not, if you don't mind me asking?"
"I just don't think it makes a difference. I don't think those folks care about us, so why should I vote?" he replied.
Not a surprising sentiment in our district - where less than [39% of eligible voters](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/eedf6bee-9d84-4287-9c31-59c7265696c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) turn out for a midterm election - but one I find disheartening regardless.
"What would you want our leaders to focus on, if you could tell them?" I asked.
"Blue collar issues. Working people. Not just people with the most money."
That's what I want our leaders to focus on too. We talked more about how corporations have too much control, and too many in government aren't working for us anymore. And I shared that's a big reason I was running, and asked him if there has ever been a candidate or a politician that he felt was fighting for those same things he cared about. And if there was, if that would get him to vote.
"No, I haven't. And no - because at the end of the day, I leave it up to God. Voting doesn't make a difference, because God is in control."
I'm no theologian, but I'm reminded of a Biblical passage we talked a lot about in my house growing up about the relationship between faith and action, and also a story often told in sermons across faith traditions: t**he parable of the man in the flood.** If you're not familiar, it goes a little something like this:
A terrible storm begins to flood a small town. As the waters rise, a man kneels in prayer as his home fills with water. Soon a neighbor comes by in a canoe and says: "Get in, the waters are rising fast!"
"No," replies the man. "I have faith in God. He will save me."
The waters continue to rise, and the man soon has to move to the second story of his home, at which point another guy zips up in a motorboat. "We gotta get you outta here as the levee's about to break!"
Again, the man refuses. "God will rescue me."
Soon, the levee breaks, and the flood waters rise even more. The man retreats to his roof, at which point a helicopter with rescuers appears and drops a ladder.
"Grab the ladder!" The rescuers holler through a megaphone.
Once again, the man refuses, insisting that God will deliver him from the flood.
When he drowns and arrives in heaven, he asks God, confused: "I had unwavering faith that you would save me. Why didn't you rescue me from the flood?"
**God replies: "I sent you two boats and a helicopter. What more did you expect?"**
If you've been around this campaign for a minute, you'll know our slogan:
### _**Put Hope to Work**_
That means showing up in a boat as the flood waters rise, bringing our neighbors to dry land, and not stopping until we've got everyone we can reach. I don't know if I changed that man's mind - but I do know I'll be back doorknocking in his neighborhood, because I'm not willing to leave anyone behind.
In hope and action,
Michaela

## The SAVE Act...
The fake-news media is in hysterics.

Now, their latest outrage has to do with a piece of legislation working its way through Congress.
The SAVE Act is "voter suppression."
It's "Jim Crow 2.0," or some sinister Republican plot to dismantle democracy.
It's the same leftist gaslighting we've heard for years.
But was does the SAVE Act actually do?
Here's the truth: The Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act requires proof of U.S. citizenship to register for federal elections.
Translation: non-citizens and illegals can't sway our elections--a problem that has gone unaddressed for far too long.
I address this problem in my new book:
_We also know why the Democrats love open borders. It isn 't just about cultivating future voters (giving them a pathway to citizenship); it's also about affecting the census. It's about bodies in the country, not just citizens._
So let's break down why this common sense legislation has the Left besides themselves...

# Trump launches "Product of USA" label
The Trump administration has launched a new national campaign for the "Product of USA" label, **[reserved exclusively](https://substack.com/redirect/b3c24fe7-9c92-420f-b718-fa626d9e7a3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for meat, poultry, and egg products where the animals are born, raised, harvested, and processed **[entirely in the United States.](https://substack.com/redirect/b3c24fe7-9c92-420f-b718-fa626d9e7a3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b3c24fe7-9c92-420f-b718-fa626d9e7a3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **True American standard:** The new voluntary USDA label ensures meat, poultry, and eggs are 100% born, raised, harvested, and processed in the USA with strict documentation and oversight.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a42d21c8-47bc-4322-909d-a2505ea0ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **White House push:** The Trump administration is actively promoting the label to give consumers clear transparency and support American farmers and ranchers.

[ Click Here](https://substack.com/redirect/eb08da3d-b4ba-483e-b37b-daf3323e2951?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
# Trump Admin redirects $928M from Wind to Oil
The Trump Department of the Interior reached an agreement with TotalEnergies to **[scrap Biden-era offshore wind leases](https://substack.com/redirect/c3795907-7152-40b8-91e5-a149ba7b1f12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and redirect $928 million into U.S. oil, natural gas, and LNG production under the energy dominance agenda.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c3795907-7152-40b8-91e5-a149ba7b1f12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Wind Leases Terminated** : The U.S. will terminate wind farm leases in the Carolina Long Bay Area and New York Bight area granted to TotalEnergies by the Biden administration in 2022.
**New Oil and LNG Investments** : TotalEnergies will invest in a liquefied natural gas plant in Brownsville, Texas, plus shale gas production and upstream conventional oil in the Gulf of America.
**National Security Pause** : The department paused all leases for large-scale offshore wind projects under construction due to national security risks.
**Energy Dominance Goal** : Interior Secretary Doug Burgum called it a win for affordable and reliable energy, lowering costs for families and increasing baseload and grid reliability.
* * *
* * *
# Toyota invests $1B in US plants amid tariffs
Toyota will spend **[$1 billion to boost production at its Kentucky and Indiana plants](https://substack.com/redirect/1f21ee23-cf94-4db0-9579-34619f12cd0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as part of a plan to invest up to $10 billion domestically over the next five years, citing its philosophy of building where it sells.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1f21ee23-cf94-4db0-9579-34619f12cd0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Kentucky and Indiana Focus** : The investment includes $800 million at the Georgetown, Kentucky plant for more Camry sedans and RAV4 crossovers plus $200 million at the Princeton, Indiana plant for Grand Highlander SUVs.
**Long Term US Commitment** : Toyota Motor North America Chief Operating Officer Mark Templin said the investment is for the long-term, tied to building where we sell and buying where we build.
**Tariff Cost Warning** : Toyota previously warned U.S. tariffs are expected to cost the automaker 1.4 trillion yen for its fiscal year ending this month.
**Export Plans Advance** : Toyota was the first Japanese automaker to commit to exporting U.S.-produced vehicles to Japan following last year's trade deal changes.
* * *
* * *
# US to boost diesel supply as prices hit $5.29
Energy Secretary Chris Wright said **[the Trump administration plans to bring extra diesel to the marketplace](https://substack.com/redirect/fb0d3bad-b8ce-4843-89a2-69fcf3db485c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** soon as diesel prices surged about 40% to $5.29 per gallon amid the Iran war supply disruption.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fb0d3bad-b8ce-4843-89a2-69fcf3db485c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**SPR Release Underway** : The U.S. will release about 1 million to 1.5 million barrels per day from its Strategic Petroleum Reserve, with emergency releases possibly reaching nearly 3 million barrels per day total.
**IEA Global Action** : More than 30 nations agreed on March 11 to inject 400 million barrels into the global market, with the U.S. contributing 172 million barrels.
**No Export Limits** : Wright stated blocking exports would force refineries to turn down and produce less, which would not be productive for the United States or the world.
**Price Signal View** : Markets do what markets do, with prices rising to signal producers to make more, though they have not risen high enough yet for meaningful demand destruction.
* * *
* * *
# EU faces higher tariffs if Trade Deal fails
US Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder warned that[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/bfab09cc-df76-4b4b-b534-3f8ef8fb2d25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[if the EU-US trade deal fails, the EU will face increased tariffs](https://substack.com/redirect/bfab09cc-df76-4b4b-b534-3f8ef8fb2d25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while nothing changes for the US, calling it economic malpractice not to pass the pact.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bfab09cc-df76-4b4b-b534-3f8ef8fb2d25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**15 Percent Ceiling Deal** : The agreement sets a 15% ceiling tariff on most EU goods in exchange for eliminating duties on many US products, with a sunset clause in March 2028 unless extended.
**Metals Tariff Pressure** : Lawmakers want the US to reduce the 50% metals tariff broadened to cover hundreds of products containing steel and aluminum.
**Supreme Court Impact** : The deal was thrown into doubt after the Supreme Court struck down Trump's global tariffs last month, prompting a temporary 10% levy on all imports.
**South Korea Warning** : Puzder pointed to Trump's January threat of 25% tariffs on South Korea for not living up to a prior pact as an example of potential ramifications.
* * *
* * *
# Black Rock's Larry Fink: Stay invested, avoid market timing
BlackRock CEO Larry Fink **[warned investors against trying to time the market,](https://substack.com/redirect/95a5ad5a-7f95-4c45-94a6-b45b1221e496?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** noting that missing the 10 best days in the S&P 500 over the past two decades would have cut returns by more than half.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/95a5ad5a-7f95-4c45-94a6-b45b1221e496?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Staying Invested Matters** : Over time, staying invested has mattered far more than getting the timing right, especially as some of the market's strongest days came amid unsettling headlines.
**Global Capitalism Shift** : The old model of global capitalism is fracturing, with countries spending enormous sums to become self-reliant in energy, defense, and technology.
**AI Wealth Concentration** : The massive wealth created flowed mostly to people who already owned financial assets, and AI threatens to repeat that pattern at an even larger scale.
**Headline Noise Danger** : The danger is focusing so much on the noise that we forget what actually matters, amid rapid shifts in sentiment tied to geopolitics and disruption.
* * *
* * *
# Elon Musk launches Terafab chip venture
Elon Musk **[announced Terafab, a joint venture between Tesla, SpaceX, and xAI](https://substack.com/redirect/846531c1-0d10-4d60-bd29-f21081765947?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to build advanced semiconductor production including chip design, fabrication, memory, and packaging at Giga Texas in Austin.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/846531c1-0d10-4d60-bd29-f21081765947?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Massive Scale Ambition** : The facility aims to produce more than a terawatt of AI computing power per year, most destined for space, on a site planned to dwarf Giga Texas.
**Optimus Demand Driver** : The Optimus program is the single biggest driver, with Giga Texas targeting capacity for 10 million humanoid robots per year requiring 20 million chips.
**Chip Shortage Response** : Musk said current AI compute output is roughly 20 gigawatts per year and the rest of the world's output is about 2% of what his companies need.
**Process and Cost** : Terafab will pursue 2-nanometer process technology with initial costs in the $20 billion to $25 billion range.
* * *
* * *
# Moody's Downgrades KKR Private Credit Fund to Junk
Moody's **[downgraded the debt ratings of FS KKR Capital Corp](https://substack.com/redirect/85cd30a4-cec7-4ab9-b5e6-bfcd0e970377?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** one notch to Ba1, entering junk territory, citing continued asset quality challenges, rising bad loans, and weaker profitability.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/85cd30a4-cec7-4ab9-b5e6-bfcd0e970377?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Non Accrual Loans Rise** : Non-accrual loans reached 5.5% of total investments at the end of 2025, one of the highest rates among rated business development companies.
**Financial Results Weak** : The fund posted a net loss of $114 million in the fourth quarter and only $11 million net income for all of 2025.
**Software Exposure High** : The largest loan category is software and related services, comprising 16.4% of exposure at year-end.
**Share Price Impact** : Shares of FSK dropped 4% in morning trading and have plunged more than 30% this year.
### Apollo Private Credit Fund Limits Withdrawals to 45%
Apollo Global Management's $15 billion private credit fund **[will return only about 45% of requested withdrawals](https://substack.com/redirect/9327eabe-fb8e-4bf2-8cde-dcee82951f3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after receiving redemption requests equal to 11.2% of shares, exceeding the 5% quarterly cap.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9327eabe-fb8e-4bf2-8cde-dcee82951f3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Redemption Cap Maintained** : The fund will return approximately $730 million on a prorated basis while keeping the 5% quarterly redemption limit to protect long-term value.
**NAV Performance** : Net asset value per share declined 1.2% over the past three months through February 28, still outperforming the U.S. Leveraged Loan Index which fell 2.2%.
**Software Sector Risk** : Software represents 12.3% of the portfolio, the single biggest sector, amid broader concerns over loans to software companies.
**Fiduciary Duty Statement** : Apollo said the decision reflects its commitment to long-term value creation and balancing interests of shareholders seeking liquidity with those remaining invested.

body:
Virginia voters still have a say but time is running out.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260324-381&t=1&akid=381%2E12592%2E6MhfnB)
[](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260324_2.IUNZEA&amount=3&refcode=20260324-381&t=2&akid=381%2E12592%2E6MhfnB)
It’s Pete Aguilar, Chair of the Democratic Caucus in the House of Representatives. I’m coming to you today with an important message: **I’m fully supporting the YES campaign for redistricting in Virginia.**
Right now, politicians across the country are trying to rewrite the rules to benefit themselves before voters ever get a chance to weigh in.
It’s the same pattern we’ve seen time and again, putting power ahead of people and making it harder for voters to have their voices heard.
_That’s why what’s happening in Virginia right now matters so much._
With early voting already underway and election day on April 21, Virginians have the opportunity to vote YES and approve a constitutional amendment that protects Virginia voters and stops Trump’s power grabs.
But make no mistake, Republicans and powerful interests are working to stop this.
They’re spending big to confuse voters and block this amendment because they know when voters are informed they lose. And accountability means they can’t rig the system to protect themselves.
That’s why Virginians for Fair Elections is working every day to reach voters, cut through the noise, and make sure people understand what’s at stake.
_But they can’t do it alone._
[**Can you chip in $3 or more today to help support this effort and make sure voters, not politicians, decide our elections?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260324_2.IUNZEA&amount=3&refcode=20260324-381&t=3&akid=381%2E12592%2E6MhfnB)
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260324_2.IUNZEA&amount=3&refcode=20260324-381&t=22&akid=381%2E12592%2E6MhfnB)**
Thank you,
Pete Aguilar
U.S. Representative, California’s 33rd District

name: Katie Porter
subject: A big difference between myself and the other two top Democrats
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=41026%2E3422442%2E5vKUEN)
Peter,
The ACLU put out its voter guide in the race for California Governor and there’s a BIG difference between myself and the other two top Democrats. Take a look ⤵️
[](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260324_1_ak.bag_Er&refcode=em20260324-41026&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41026%2E3422442%2E5vKUEN)
The other leading candidates in this race couldn’t be bothered to denounce ICE’s immoral, unconstitutional attacks on our communities.
As a leader, I’ve always put my values first. That’s why in the face of ICE attacking communities across California and the country, **_I called to abolish ICE._**
Meanwhile, even _after_ Donald Trump unleashed federal agents on Los Angeles, my opponent **_Eric Swalwell voted to thank ICE._**
And the billionaire in this race, Tom Steyer, **_made his billions investing in the same private prisons that ICE is using right now to detain thousands of immigrants._**
_That’s BS._
I have consistently stood up for California’s immigrant community. I don’t change my voice depending on how the political winds blow, because what is right is right, always. **ICE needs to be abolished, not thanked.**
California’s next governor needs to be clear eyed about protecting our communities from Donald Trump’s thugs. That’s exactly the type of governor I will be.
**[But with just 41 days until ballots drop, I need your help to win this primary election. If you also believe California needs a governor with consistent values, I hope you’ll chip in to my campaign today.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260324_1_ak.bag_Er&refcode=em20260324-41026&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=41026%2E3422442%2E5vKUEN)**
[Donate ›››](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260324_1_ak.bag_Er&refcode=em20260324-41026&t=23&akid=41026%2E3422442%2E5vKUEN)
Thank you,
Katie Porter

Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4g-em-footer?refcode=em20260324-41026&amounts=&t=24&refcode2=41026_3422442_5vKUEN&akid=41026%2E3422442%2E5vKUEN)**

Thank you, Katie Porter Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change.

| | | When I was in college, my roommates' standup improv comedy troupe (The Purple Crayon) was a staple of life. I spent many nights in my four years in college laughing hilariously at a dozen college kids throwing around wild ideas and responding prompts. One of those students was Chris Rabb. The thing about knowing someone for over three decades is you really know who they a re and what they are made of. He's fun, generous, honest, and super-insightful young man--and he's got nerves of steel when facing powerful interests. He is committed to shaking up politics for more democracy and less inequality. He isn't afraid of calling what is happening in Gaza a genocide, he refuses SuperPAC money, and he isn't afraid to criticize Democrats. Eight years ago, he ran for office, and won- against the preferred Democratic party insider--and has been representing his district in Philly brilliantly. Now he's running for Congress in a wide open seat (incumbent retiring) and just got some [big grassroots endorsements](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/40fde860?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21). Rabb is beloved in his community and by air and water advocates: he has fought for fracking transparency, for urban ag (and bees!) and introduced a first-of-its-kind bill to prohibit companies from using deceptive marketing terms like "net zero" or "cleaner energy" to mislead consumers.[**I 'd like you to help him a small grassroots donations. **](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/0ef936ab?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)**He is now tied for first place in polls in THE bluest Congressional seat in the nation!** He is honest and trustworthy, and not about to go to Congress to get a long. **That 's part of why dark money Super PACs are spending millions of dollars to defeat his grassroots people-backed movement for Congress in PA-03.**His opponents are establishment politicians who haven't shown his bravery, and Chris keeps getting great polling numbers, but he just doesn't have the big money. [**Unless you help him now, they will win.**](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/2c570f70?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)**March 31 filing deadline and there 's a fundraiser in NYC in five days--if you're in the city, please come by!**Time: March 29, 11 am to 1 pm
Location on RSVP in NYC
Link:
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rabb-3-29-brunch](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/511730df?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)Thanks. He will win if he raises the money--I'm confident of that--so you can help put him in that position, and then enjoy his rapier mind going after big oil and gas executives in Congress, and standing up when others sit down. Thanks for supporting an old friend,Zephyr

clean_body: | | Dear Friend, This Saturday, March 28th, communities across our district will be gathering for the No Kings rallies --and we need your help to make sure Team Bradstock has a strong presence at each one. We're looking for volunteers to help staff campaign tables and carry Bradstock signs at four locations: Fayette County 🕙 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM 📍 Fayette County Courthouse Westmoreland County 🕛 12:00 PM - 2:00 PM 📍 Westmoreland County Courthouse Washington County 🕛 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM 📍 Washington County Courthouse Indiana County 🕑 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM 📍 Indiana County Courthouse A strong presence at these events helps show visible support, connect with voters, and build the momentum we need across the district. 👉 Sign up here to volunteer at a rally: You've already shown your support--now we're ready to take the next step together. We're organizing volunteers across the district and want to learn how you'd like to plug in, whether it's knocking doors, making calls, hosting house parties, helping at events, or engaging your community. 👉Please take a moment to fill out our brief volunteer survey below so we can match you with the best opportunities to get involved. This campaign is powered by people like you. Showing up, talking to neighbors, and being visible in the community is how we win. Thanks for being part of the team--we hope to see you on Saturday! Best, Kate Rullo Team Bradstock Volunteer Director | ~~ "Facebook" "Instagram" mailto:info@bradstockforcongress.com "Email" ~ "Bluesky" "X" ~ "YouTube" Bradstock for Congress P.O. body:
Peter,

Our first end-of-quarter fundraising deadline of the year is coming up.

And what gets reported at the end of this quarter won't just sit in a filing cabinet— _it will be public for everyone (including our opponents and deep-pocketed Republicans) to see._

It will shape how this campaign is seen, how much momentum we have, and whether or not we're positioned to reelect Wesley to represent our district this November.

At the same time, the work hasn't slowed down, **not even for a second.** Wesley has been focused on delivering real results for St. Louisans—not headlines, not talking points, but tangible investments in the community. That means:
* **$3.1 million secured to modernize power infrastructure at St. Louis Lambert International Airport**

* **$1 million delivered to Ferguson to revitalize the Farmers Market and create a permanent, accessible community space**

* **Support for a bipartisan effort to expand Gateway Arch National Park into East St. Louis**

* **Introduction of the _EPSTEIN Act_ to push for transparency and accountability at the federal level**

This is what it looks like to stay focused on what matters: investing in infrastructure, looking out for our community, and fighting for accountability. _It's also exactly why reelecting Wesley in November is so important._

But reaching our critical end-of-quarter fundraising goal is going to take resources—and how this team chooses to show up in moments like this one can shape the entire trajectory of this election.

A strong end-of-quarter report sends a clear message that this campaign has momentum, and we have what it takes to win. | | , Groceries cost too much. Housing costs too much. Health care costs too much. Utility bills keep going up. Let's face it. The system feels rigged against working people. That is not an accident. And as your Attorney General, I am going to change that. I will create a **Division of Affordability and Value** at the Office of the Attorney General. Its mission will be simple and direct. We will use the law every single day to help Texans protect their consumer rights and bring down inflated costs. That means going after junk fees that drain your bank account.
It means holding insurance companies accountable so claims are paid fully and on time.
It means challenging utility rate hikes that hit families month after month.
It means enforcing consumer protection laws against predatory lenders, scammers, and bad actors who take advantage of working Texans. And it means something bigger. **It means recognizing that corruption is a hidden tax on every family. When insiders cut deals and corporations get special treatment, we pay the price. I will root that out and hold people accountable.** The Attorney General should not be a spectator while Texans struggle. The office has power, and it should use that power for the people. [**If you believe in this mission, I need your help. We need the power of the people behind us to secure the resources to win this race. body:
Colorado saw red flags in autism therapy billing and approved higher rates anyway
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). And also, check out our [deep-dive video of the day](https://link.email.joinrmv.) on the Colorado's very own Medicaid scandal!
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Lawmakers are scrambling to address a [growing $1.5 billion budget gap](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Meanwhile, a federal audit uncovered at least $77.8 million in [improper autism therapy payments](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and over $200 million more in questionable costs, along with findings that the state does not require background checks for some workers serving children. State officials approved higher reimbursement rates for this program even as spending surged and warning signs mounted.

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** A lawsuit alleges the state [kept minors in detention despite court orders for release](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while new ballot measures targeting oil and gas could impose [stricter liability rules and shift costs within the energy sector](https://link.email.joinrmv.). In the 4th Congressional District,[ Democrat Eileen Laubacher’s rapid rise and $6.4 million fundraising hau](https://link.email.joinrmv.)l—much from out of state—are drawing scrutiny amid an ongoing legal challenge over her eligibility.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** A U.S. citizen has reportedly taken control of a major Mexican cartel as the Supreme Court weighs a [challenge to birthright citizenship](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while justices also consider [whether mail-in ballots must be received by Election Day](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Meanwhile, [ICE agents are being deployed to airports](https://link.email.joinrmv.) to assist TSA during staffing shortages tied to the ongoing government shutdown.
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, March 24, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado saw red flags in autism therapy billing and approved higher rates anyway](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
Every week, parents of autistic children in Colorado dropped their kids off with behavior therapists they trusted. What they didn’t know—what the state never required anyone to verify—was whether those therapists had passed a background check. Many hadn’t. Not because anyone failed a background check. Because Colorado never required one.
The findings from federal auditors came out in February. At least $77.8 million in improper Medicaid payments for autism therapy in 2022 and 2023 were identified. And pointed to an additional $207.4 million in question.
Not a single case in the audit sample was clean. And buried in the same report was a finding that went largely unnoticed—one that goes beyond the money.
Colorado is fighting the refund.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[From party switch to $6.4 million: Examining the rise of a CD4 candidate](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Candidate’s rapid rise follows recent party switch:** Eileen Laubacher registered as a Republican for decades before switching to Democrat in 2025, then quickly launched a congressional bid despite no prior primary voting history.

* **Residency, eligibility, and timeline face legal scrutiny:** Questions have emerged over her residency and ballot eligibility, including a lawsuit alleging party officials adjusted timelines to meet a 12-month registration requirement.

* **Fundraising dominated by out-of-state support:** Laubacher raised more than $6.4 million in under eight months, with a large share of contributions coming from outside Colorado, reflecting a nationalized campaign profile rather than a district-based one.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**

**[Colorado Budget Gap Swells To $1.5 Billion As Lawmakers Brace For Cuts](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [DENVER](https://link.email.joinrmv.)7
* **Budget deficit surges to $1.5 billion:** New state forecasts show Colorado must close a $1.5 billion gap—up sharply from about $1 billion just days earlier—putting pressure on lawmakers to act quickly.

* **Short timeline forces urgent spending decisions:** Lawmakers have roughly a week to finalize the budget and identify cuts, with the updated projections shaping last-minute decisions on state spending.

* **Conflicting forecasts add uncertainty to budgeting process:** Competing projections from legislative economists and the governor’s office show significant differences in expected revenue, complicating efforts to balance the budget.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**

**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Born for Battle: A New Identity, A New Fight](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | MARCH 22** _Most of us remember the classic story “The Ugly Duckling.” A small bird is born on a farmyard, but something about him seems... off. The ducks mock him. The chickens peck at him. Everywhere he goes, the message is the same: “You’re awkward.” “You don’t belong.” “Something must be wrong with you.” So, the little duck grows up believing the lie: This is just who I am._
__
**[Why hatred for capitalism reveals more about you than the system](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY C. J. GARBO | COMMENTARY | MARCH 20** _Some people claim to hate capitalism. What they often hate is not the system itself, but their perceived place within it. They see business leaders as exploiters. They see profit as theft. They see success as evidence of injustice. This mindset reveals more about the individual than it does about capitalism._ __
**[Trump re-endorses Hurd in CD3: Says Scheppelman will exit race](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
**[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 20** _President Donald Trump on Friday morning reversed course in Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District, re-endorsing Rep. Jeff Hurd and announcing that former challenger Hope Scheppelman would step out of the race to join his administration—a move she later confirmed in a campaign statement._

That is voter suppression — not election security.

name: Wes Moore
subject: My team has been sending me updates about the conflict in Iran
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1248%2E1086043%2ELYMBjL)
Each day since the conflict with Iran began, my team has been sending me updates.
They arrive throughout the day -- text messages, phone calls, emails. At first, the updates were numbers. How many American women and men we had lost.
**But war does not stay a number for long.**
Soon, the names begin to come in. The hometowns. The communities that raised them. The families whose lives have just changed forever.
I’ll never forget the familiar weight in my chest on March 4 when the first names reached my phone: _Capt. Cody A. Khork, Sgt. 1st Class Noah L. Tietjens, Sgt. 1st Class Nicole M. Amor, Sgt. Declan J. Coady, Maj. Jeffrey R. O'Brien, Chief Warrant Officer 3 Robert M. Marzan._
Just over a week later, six more Americans were killed when a U.S. refueling aircraft crashed over Iraq: _Major John A. Klinner, Captain Ariana G. Savino, Technical Sergeant Ashley B. Pruitt, Captain Seth R. Koval, Captain Curtis J. Angst, Technical Sergeant Tyler H. Simmons._
**This is how war reaches you. Not all at once, but hour by hour. First a number. Then a name. Then a hometown. Then the quiet realization that somewhere in America, a family has just received the worst phone call of their lives.**
Maryland has many service members and military families -- so I ask for these updates to know when someone in our communities has been impacted by the president’s war.
**_But the truth is, it’s also deeply personal._**
I served in uniform. I know the gravity of the oath these men and women took -- and for those who have worn the uniform, it’s not an abstract concept. It is the faces of the people who stood beside you. It is the empty space left behind when someone doesn’t come home.
Because of that experience, I take this type of service -- and the decisions that place our service members in harm’s way -- with the utmost seriousness.
Every day since the war started, I have taken a moment to pause and recognize the fallen. To speak their names out loud, even when no one else is around. To reflect on their sacrifice. To show them the respect they deserve.
These are Americans who gave their last full measure of devotion for the cause of freedom. And the families they leave behind are carrying a burden most of us will never fully understand.
**The American people deserve a commander-in-chief who seeks to lighten that burden and heal those wounds. Instead, while families across this country are still receiving the worst phone calls of their lives,_the president has circulated fundraising emails featuring the image of a fallen service member’s casket._**
**It’s disgusting. It’s wrong. You don’t have to be a veteran to feel that way. You just know it.**
But I still have faith that the president’s inhumanity doesn’t have to define us. That while he has one, big powerful voice, the people are louder if we all speak as one.
So in this time of hardship, let’s do what we can to honor the fallen the right way -- by remembering their names, by standing with their families, and by honoring their sacrifice in any way we can (if you want to donate money, many families of the fallen have set up fundraising pages -- any amount can make a big difference).
In the Army, I learned the Soldier's Creed to Leave No One Behind. It isn’t just a motto, it’s a way of living -- a way of serving. Let’s all do what we can to measure up to that code, now and always.
Elevate,
Wes

subject: Who is this war *really* for?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1001&akid=1889%2E251025%2EHUa3y1 ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1002&akid=1889%2E251025%2EHUa3y1 ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter,

Donald Trump and his MAGA buddies are saying his war with Iran is about
“liberation.”

That’s the word they're using to sell us on this illegal, costly war, and
I’m not buying it for a second.

What kind of liberation comes at the end of a missile to a girls' school?

What's liberating about sending another generation of U.S. service members
to die on killing fields in the Middle East for an unjustified war?

Here's the question nobody in Washington wants you asking right now: Who
is this war *really* for?

I’ll tell you now, it’s not us. This war has already cost American
taxpayers billions of dollars, and counting:

[ A ]A live tracker of the increasing cost of the Iran war. Credit:
https://iran-cost-ticker.com/

Grocery prices aren't any cheaper. People still can't afford healthcare.
The idea of ever owning a home is still out of reach.

This is a distraction,
Peter. When politicians can't
solve your problems, they distract you with chaos and war. But don't
worry, somebody does benefit — just not you...

The weapons manufacturers are making a killing.

Raytheon's PAC gave over $1.2 million to federal candidates. Boeing gave
more than $1.5 million. Lockheed Martin, $1.5 million. Northrop Grumman,
$1.2 million.

This is what happens when corporations spend millions of dollars to buy
off politicians. War becomes good business.

And they're not the only ones. That's why you've got Democrats bending
over backwards to justify Trump's illegal war in Iran.

What do they all have in common? They took money from AIPAC.

War is never free. It's always paid for, most of all by the service
members who put their lives on the line, the families who wait desperately
for them, the casualties lost to these wars, and you and me, watching our
groceries, our healthcare, our housing get further out of reach.

This war is illegal. It's immoral, unjustifiable, and wrong.

If I were in the U.S. Senate, I wouldn’t vote to authorize it, and I
wouldn’t vote to fund it. I would use all of myself and all of my voice to
get us the hell out of this mess.

That is exactly why corporate PACs — like those weapons manufacturers —
and AIPAC are going to spend millions to stop me. They know I can’t be
bought.

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

clean_body: | | | | | | | | Hi, This is Brigadier General James Emory Mace, U.S. Army (Retired). Today, I write to you not as a soldier... but as a father. I’m a Vietnam War Veteran and Purple Heart Medal recipient. I’ve worn the uniform. I’ve buried friends who never made it home. And I’ve felt the sting of a Nation that sometimes forgets what our sacrifices were for. But my daughter - Congresswoman Nancy Mace - never forgot. Nancy was raised in the shadow of the flag. She saw the uniform. She lived with the deployments. She knew the cost. And instead of running from it, she ran toward it. That’s the kind of person -the kind of fighter \- she is. When Nancy was 17, she dropped out of high school. Most kids in that situation fall apart. But not Nancy. I raised her to believe that setbacks don’t define you -how you rise does. She grew up hearing the same lessons over and over again: 👉 Never quit. 👉 Never run from the truth.👉 And never let anyone tell you thatyou are less than what God made you to be. So I gave her a choice: She picked herself up, took a job at Waffle House, and fought her way back. By 21, she became the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, following in my footsteps. Soon after, she was elected as the first woman to represent South Carolina in the U.S. House of Representatives. She’s been fighting her whole life; for herself, for her kids, for the truth, and now...for her state. Nancy led an evacuation mission in the Middle East after learning a South Carolina family was stranded. Because when your people are stuck in a war zone getting hit with missiles and rockets, the only answer worthy of the office -worthy of our country \- is to get them out. She flew into an active war zone and answered the call when Americans needed help. As a father - and as a Purple Heart Veteran \- I’ve never been more proud of my daughter. That’s why it’s hard when I have to watch Nancy face relentless attacks day after day. Each day that goes out there and fights for you, she’s up against the Establishment’s knife. They stalk her. Send her death threats. She’s even been physically assaulted. But Nancy is my daughter. And I know this: She never backs down. And she never stops fighting. I want to ask you something from one parent, one patriot, to another: Will you support my daughter in the toughest battle of her life? But even in the face of all that, Nancy stood up for me. 👉 She stood up for EVERY veteran who was forgotten. 👉 She stood up for stranded American families and rescued them from an active Middle East warzone.👉 She stood up when other Republicans stayed silent. And now, she’s standing up for YOU. But she needs your backup. I may not wear the uniform anymore, but I still believe in answering the call. Will you answer it with me today? Nancy’s not running to make friends. She’s running to win. To fight. To serve. That’s what she learned growing up in our home. That’s what she learned watching me go off to war. And that’s what she’ll carry with her to the Governor’s Mansion. May God bless you and your family. With respect, General James Emory Mace (Ret.) Proud Father of Nancy Mace | | | | | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter. Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained. At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts. By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina. Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks. She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history. Nancy is fighting to: Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front. South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started. | | | | | | | | Paid for by Nancy Mace For Governor | | Copyright © 2025 , All rights reserved.

Peter,

Five years ago, I gathered with patriots from all corners of America to protest the certification of the 2020 election results.

All we wanted was for President Trump to get a fair shake, for mail-in vote counts to be redone, and to ensure no fraud had taken place. However, President Trump's enemies saw us coming, and they were ready and waiting to pull off perhaps the biggest psy-op America has ever seen.

Capitol Police officers welcomed many J6ers into the building, with some even providing off-the-cuff tours as they ushered protestors through the halls of the Capitol.

All of a sudden, though, things took a very dark turn...
* A Capitol Police officer murdered Ashli Babbitt.
* Overzealous officers assaulted protestors.
* Rosann Boyland was trampled to death in the panic that ensued as the Capitol Police swiftly turned on peaceful protestors.

For many, like myself, this day marked the beginning of a years-long political persecution that tore families apart, devastated finances, and even denied many of us our freedom and our fundamental human rights.

It also motivated me to start Stand in the Gap -- a commitment to stand in solidarity with and fight for those who are being overlooked or mistreated.

Our goal is to provide support and advocacy for those in need, ensuring they aren't left to face their challenges alone.

Stand in the Gap originally started to help reunite families with a loved one incarcerated due to J6.

**Now, our focus is on helping the recently released J6ers navigate the challenging process of re-entry into society after being incarcerated.**

Surprisingly, there are very few resources for people who are released from prison, particularly if they are conservative, America First activists, or who supported President Trump.

These J6ers are our neighbors. They are sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, mothers and fathers. It is up to us to ensure that they have the resources needed to rebuild their lives and reclaim their dignity.

We were founded to "stand in the gap" for those in prison and those navigating life after incarceration.

subject: You’re not an ATM
body:
---
Derek, If you’re on other email lists, you probably receive panicked emails from PACs and politicians trying to scare you into donating. That’s especially true right now, with the end-of-quarter FEC deadline just around the corner and November’s midterm elections rapidly approaching. Maybe you’re already seeing your inbox flooded with requests for donations. But here’s what we believe, Derek:
* **You are _not_ an ATM.** You are an invaluable part of our organization and our mission.
* We strive to give you valuable information about the DNC’s work that we hope will inspire you to join us — not scare you into making a rushed decision based on a false sense of urgency.

body:
#
Peter,
**I’m sick of the two sets of rules in this country – one for the rich and well-connected, and one for everyone else.**
And I’m angry when I see politicians like my opponent, Jon Husted, protect their billionaire donors at all costs.
Here’s what happened: Husted received more than $116,000 in donations from Jeffrey Epstein’s co-conspirator Leslie Wexner.
Then recently, Wexner testified before Congress about his relationship with Epstein and admitted to backing Husted, saying, “I’m sure I helped him. I helped him politically.”
And it gets worse. Husted didn’t just take Wexner’s money – **he accepted a maximum donation _just weeks_ before voting to block the release of the Epstein files.**
You do the math.
This is why when people say the system is rigged, they’re right. Politically connected insiders avoid consequences as victims are pushed aside. Billionaires get tax breaks while working families pay more for health insurance. And elites do whatever the hell they want while regular folks are told to just be grateful and “earn more.”
Ohioans deserve better.
I’ve spent my career holding powerful interests accountable, and I’m not stopping anytime soon. But I need your help.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

body:
Here’s where we stand.
| | | | |
---
I want to be frank about where we stand, Peter.

**March has been a slow month, and we’re running out of time to course correct.**
As we quickly approach the end of this quarter, Trump and Senate Republicans are watching our campaign’s every move. If we fall behind on fundraising, my opponent’s right-wing megadonors will think they can buy New Hampshire’s open Senate seat.
**_Right now we’re not where we need to be._** So I have to ask: **[Will you make sure that we don’t fall short by splitting a $5 donation between me and Roy Cooper before our critical end-of-quarter fundraising deadline?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7499?t=6&akid=819%2E124072%2EJm2WzB)**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Chris Pappas and Roy Cooper will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7500?t=7&akid=819%2E124072%2EJm2WzB)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7501?t=8&akid=819%2E124072%2EJm2WzB)
---
| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7502?t=9&akid=819%2E124072%2EJm2WzB)
---
| | [DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7503?t=10&akid=819%2E124072%2EJm2WzB)
---
**This month is the most important yet in our campaign.** After March 31st our fundraising numbers will go public. That means everyone from Donald Trump to right-wing super PACs will be watching to see if we have what it takes to win in November.
With the Senate majority on the line, we can’t afford to sit back now. We have to build our momentum right away.
**[Please, Peter, chip in anything you can between my campaign and Roy Cooper's campaign to help us meet this moment and defend New Hampshire’s open Senate seat.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7503?t=11&akid=819%2E124072%2EJm2WzB)**
Thank you,

Chris
| |
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

What I saw made me **furious** , but it perfectly illustrates why I'm running for California Attorney General. This business is being crushed. | | | | | [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001y4IG_Z0a36vMB_8saom86E5e2uaAH6YrSu6ljlrHqJc4eo5fupZaEWD-GKvlHKLB3I1KJtFUz7tbWc8q69rwbusRWWJux88VQn-8sMbF38GeFNgKrTdspRTYk9MV5hgpiXbGyj8fKgRj1iKGDQaAJQWhEF81M53hnNQTEAGEj4gjDB7qKypqRvChHh70_sdkZg7E6_Mg93oIIiVh_idPVX574invM4rH&c=3zEOO8N6fYY0UNFw5GFpqjVwBJ914sSyc0U2gzMcxcNuwv5dkvZ-qQ==&ch=ithx1VY7n5spRXyztRNW8PgJktprvaeqO0glv2aiuJoC_ct36jycyw==)

Peter,
Democrats are building a nationwide redistricting movement that could blow up Trump's entire election rigging scheme.
MAGA is resorting to desperate, ugly tactics to stop it.
In Virginia, they are sending racist mailers to Black voters comparing Democratic redistricting efforts to Jim Crow and the Ku Klux Klan. A flat-out lie, designed to suppress and confuse.
Now, a California GOP sheriff just seized 650,000 ballots in a naked attempt to challenge the results of Prop 50, the referendum that cleared the way for California to redraw its maps:
---
| [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001y4IG_Z0a36vMB_8saom86E5e2uaAH6YrSu6ljlrHqJc4eo5fupZaEWD-GKvlHKLB3I1KJtFUz7tbWc8q69rwbusRWWJux88VQn-8sMbF38GeFNgKrTdspRTYk9MV5hgpiXbGyj8fKgRj1iKGDQaAJQWhEF81M53hnNQTEAGEj4gjDB7qKypqRvChHh70_sdkZg7E6_Mg93o0HbuIccbTojQU00PJcoxM&c=3zEOO8N6fYY0UNFw5GFpqjVwBJ914sSyc0U2gzMcxcNuwv5dkvZ-qQ==&ch=ithx1VY7n5spRXyztRNW8PgJktprvaeqO0glv2aiuJoC_ct36jycyw==)
