And it's happening in Colorado too.
Our ballot initiative would give Democrats 3 additional seats in Congress and all but put an end to Trump's election rigging scheme.
But a MAGA-backed, dark-money-funded group called Advance Colorado, with deep ties to extremists and even Russian oligarchs, swooped in at the eleventh hour with their own redistricting ballot initiative. It's dressed up in the language of "fairness." It is anything but.
Their proposal creates an alternative redistricting process that voters would have no meaningful control over, one designed specifically to make sure Colorado never becomes a threat to MAGA's gerrymandered maps.
This changes everything.
What was a clear path to the ballot is now a two-front war. We still need to collect 200,000 signatures to get our initiative in front of voters. But now we also have to mount an offensive to keep their poison pill proposal off the ballot entirely.
If both initiatives make it to voters, MAGA wins by confusion. They don't need to beat us outright. They just need to muddy the waters enough that nothing passes.
We are not going to let that happen. But it will take everything we have and we need your help.

I was born in Camden, Arkansas, as the third of three children to my parents, Olive and Charles Tuberville. They raised me to consistently work hard and stand on principle, which I've brought with me every step of my life.

I met my wife, Suzanne, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans in 1989. We married three years later and have two amazing children, Tucker and Troy. _**They continue to make me proud every single day.**_

[](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=03b9cc475bd3440f88fedb51d852bf29&_e=GVy0yqudqyP2Ejs74zeY3dGbDFLblIzjuRfIrSNSljJc2-kHln_rDmhfD7VmXQSR6nGNE_4FQ7g9ehZ9lGBZujan0AHlE2R3-C0c0D_Jvp4kNx5xrdsanklk64P92dhSy_IGYT6C4kbrQYzAC6Pi27yD29Am4ECzScDhcKWEpDJGMds3M4dEtAWR0ozbgsGg3gyZ79pTkI4FXswcpKOMChgiCKtcsoYPlGFnT9rzVERWJWUrveyqIGFPyFJClwyCP3HAsMs_Nc6k6ypRjw7p2JXmXenhlRpTb7GcX0e4jXfX8c2uSXCsnfuHTQatAPJFRl24bHc5HjLUGUPWlVGLrq7f-nvqaPx8u7WtDSwZqS3HZQTMBsSihi23kfR8ZZKznPBbqSow2wEzifowNqs2nvEvDzlRdN0eQQ6vfpAh9VC58NQ2rnK8r5HBlCDNoGcSyELjCGNEuPmgTqgCbe1f5D4__8XA_M0XaRVUM8QyJIIRmUJGE8_VjY-Q0EMUWJvCGUp_6wBBVxmOXne_2WcZpz3KMiBr_xtdDHh1RV7Cb-gB_AnzBM-r4yUXM4xuxUbl)
After graduating from SAU, I took my first coaching job at Hermitage High School before graduating to the college level as an assistant coach at Arkansas State University.

Just two years later, I started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, where I went on to become their defensive coordinator. HAPPENING NOW

DHS Deal Takes Shape

After weeks of gridlock, Senate Republicans sent Democrats a formal [funding offer Tuesday](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLFuwyAQhp8Gb0RwYBwPDF28pWtH68xdYlQCliFOH79yH6HL6ZNO-j_9_9dtvmFMMT8-8ck-HHGmQnPFgzE0Ykwb_rSSEyPVUPYZFDipjAQ75zTrjnwgZ6Bjr4fBmqvVznWrH3q9WAqjBaWc1fehJ7w6vQSzDJpH6KI_k5QBCwpG6C-LM3bUbgn9SKS1EVa9NsLG9RJKrrwf2OLBMedyUsmXUJ5d8mtrWxXmQ8AkYNpLSgFTOp8CptMhYFLm5PPQWuX9lSnmhzzbSdw2xr3KkEpliffGu3yvsbFcy6uybJi-q4Cp2z1t75hSrG4QVj2eGP8sXfvHaoeH3wAAAP__EhV62A) that would reopen roughly 94% of the Department of Homeland Security -- covering TSA, FEMA, and the Coast Guard -- while stripping out $5.5 billion in ICE deportation funding.

Republicans would then pass ICE funding and elements of the SAVE America Act through [budget reconciliation](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGO6yAQRb8GOkcwYBwXFK9xl9duaU2YSYyEwTLE2f37lXf_YLsrnatTnI_bfMOYYn7-x5V9OOJMheaKB2NoxJg2_GwlJ0aqoewzKHCdMh3YOadZS_KBnAHJXg-DNVernZOLHywZExT2BnTQxFYxs3oEhv4B41XJ6E-TMmBBwQj95e6MHbW7h34k0toIq14bYeN6CSVX3g9s8eCYczlXyZdQVpn80tpWhfknYBIwtYWXmNLJBExLWTnzuwqYKmdsLGDqh7G_2qE7WcJMXeXw2mP76h6vTDE_u9ow8fr7lrun7R1TitUNwqrnivHHLtsfYh0evgMAAP__Mhp5pg), bypassing Democrats entirely.

However, conservatives fear this is a swamp scheme to kill the SAVE Act, as the Senate [parliamentarian could strip out many](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDEO3CAQRU-DOywYMLYLijTuNm1KCw-zu0gYLMPaye0jVjlBui_N13uj_-uxPlyIIb1-up0sXmH12a_FXeSwenLxcL9rTpGcL5jPFQQYLhQHvaa4ys5b9EZBR1aOo1aTlsZ0b4uAxqMCDThMo5439RyHwT9x0k9Bk-yCbSTRGgJmGPrNKD1Ls-Ewey-lYlp8Du8qlR5zKnReroaLQkq5pZx6zHsX7bvWozD1g8HCYLnvuz9yDDVgbgUGSwwX8X8oBkvTMliEalkzWDCn10ml3bbzj0u8VAqRUyRsmsJPwpwwxPDV8p3ShwsxaTmMQ3daf9whxlDMyLR47S7E72f1P8a8LPwNAAD__0Jtgyk) of its provisions from a reconciliation bill.

★★★
Fetterman Breaks With Democrats on Gorman Murder

Sen. John Fetterman went on Fox News Tuesday morning and [ripped his own party](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGy3CAMRb8Gd-yAYPHbgiKNu5c2pUcGeZdEBg8QJ_v3Gd4npDsajXTu3B-f6ycmTvn5HQ_y4UprLHFteBGGHgn5xL-9ZCaMLZS6ggInlZFg18yrnqIP0RmYyOt5tubDaueml7_b3Wzz_NCKPpQDS3vYnbXBatB3cHZKfnxSBiwoeMD9tjljH9pt4f6IUWsjrPp9RuzUbqHkRvXCni5KOZdBJd9COSb2r97PJsw3AYuAJWLid0BmqmMvYBkaAYsyg62A5Wd5ZblT71QPzHJjbL3JSEcJFXuT5aIqK7VzWGUvMhRmepLcK7XXOMGvOfJb_krMFOX2lgOeyBI5URawTNXH809iTs3NwqrngYm_Ivf_aPny8C8AAP__Zt-NPQ) for failing to acknowledge the murder of Loyola University Chicago freshman Sheridan Gorman by an illegal immigrant.

Jose Medina-Medina, a 25-year-old Venezuelan national, was [caught and released](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGSpCAYhJ9GMyz4YWAMCC4xm0svtH7hP6UWwRLUmbffch9hsw766-ruf6_xhSGGNP_Flaw7w-izHwuehK56wrjhu-YUCX1xeR-Bg2ZcMlBjiqNovXVeS2jJCmOUfCqhdbtYBUbzSXMNwpAyTsETxdQTF-iM7E0b7J3EJSjg0MOjm7RUvdCTe_TeCyEbxY_NY6XSuZwK7SfWcFJIKd8qp87ltY12qXUrjfzTwNDAcF1X9z-_E103tjYwHKWBIcRIM0YW1jXMO6bK0LmjkGdfId7rWcyfHJGVenhKlTk85qWynSLhbTuSp51NwVNifims4Ke0u_XbdfNFm0bxecUQf1rVXxx5WvgOAAD__4KDhWo) twice under the Biden administration -- once at the border, once after a shoplifting arrest in sanctuary-city Chicago.

DHS issued a public statement calling it a preventable tragedy and urged Gov. Pritzker [not to release Medina-Medina](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD3OnTAURFcDnZH_MKFwkYbupU2JLvYFLBkb2Rd4y4_IEr5upNGMjs7fz_yBEEPa_sCB1t1h9tnPFW4ERx4hnvClnCKCry6XWXJpGFdM6jnFWbTeOm-UbNGKYdDqlxbGtLvla89BLKb3K65ykAs6ELAM_bgoPeq1DfZ94kpqyeUo-24xSo_CLK4fvRdCNZpfpwfC2rmcKpYbKNwYUspvyqlz-Wij3YnO2qjfjZwaOT3P0635m_B5Z0cjp6s2cgox4gaRheMIW4FEzO1QNvTM5bdCVunymKiy4yoeC3P5KsR2hBLSxs5c6cwJPYOVsLD4chGDUrBSW6w_nxBjqGZoNN8OCPE_Hf1A6G3lvwAAAP__kFKKRw) from custody. Fetterman, who was the lead Democrat on the Laken Riley Act, said his colleagues are afraid of their own base.

★★★
Iran Talks Take Shape as Strikes Continue

President Trump claimed Tuesday that the U.S. and Iran have reached ["major points of agreement"](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL2SpCAUhZ8GMyy4ILYBwSZmvemG1uXHlloEC2jtefsp5xEmOyc456v6_j2XJ4YY0usv7l7bMywuu6Xi6dE25zEe-Gk5RY-u2lwWYKAoExTkkuLCO6etUwI6r_k4SvGQXKlu0zAaHAwaWCVfBagJlHFGovLr8AC2dkHfT0yABAYTDL1RQk5cGTtMznEuiGTvw2Hztbc5VV9ObOH0IaV8p5x6m_cu6q21oxLxh8BMYL6uq1_zJ_nrnu0E5hhOT-9OYE7-ol-5_KcRX28sLiA9IiZPbcG60R2L3SiIrmh3XCHGUNVIJHvtGOIPrv3C0KnhOwAA__-0NHbF) after he extended his Strait of Hormuz ultimatum by five days, citing productive back-channel conversations through Pakistan, Turkey, and Oman.

Oil prices plunged more than 10% on the news. Iran's foreign ministry flatly denied any negotiations are taking place, calling Trump's pause a ploy to lower energy prices and "buy time."

Meanwhile, a proposal is emerging for Pakistan to [host a meeting](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0L2O6yAQxfGnwV0sGD4SCorbuMttt7TGzDhBwmDFLM7jr7KPsN1pzq_4f93nO6acyuM_bhxiTzNVmg_sjLERY97x3WrJjHTE-ppBgrtIfQEzlzyrgUIkp2HgoK5Xo29GOTc8AwAojMoR-2h5tRqNXyysIBdvb2scUvhIUoMBCR7suDhtvHJLtJ5IKS2M_N4JGx9jrOXgV8eWOqdS6mfVMsa6DTk8W9sPof8JmARM53mOa30XPj-3TcDUE3EVMDntlbH2Zr1SMLwC7WfKOR3uKox8bJjyL9j-0KAH-AkAAP__RzBpbA) between U.S. and Iranian officials later this week, with Vice President Vance potentially attending. Netanyahu says Israeli strikes will continue regardless.

* * *

2028 Dems Dump AIPAC

Multiple Democratic presidential hopefuls -- including Booker, Newsom, Gallego, and Shapiro -- are [shunning AIPAC donations](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDEO3CAQRU-DOyw8YBwXFGncbdqU1hhmd0fCYAFrJ7ePvEdI94rRe6P_-7E-kCOn1y_cyfmT15DDWvEk9C0QxgP_tJwiYag-lxUUWKm0BLOmuA5dcD5YDR25YZqM_mEGa7u3G5_WzmF7jkaP2k6bR0uotufsyQMiduxuk9JgQMEMY79ZbebBbn6cQxgGLYz6HAEb1d7nVKmc2PgkTinflFPv895F927tqEL_FLAIWK7r6rdC3DYs7b4QsBw5cmNfBSx3U8Ci9M1GwLJj-isD7dkXbPIoVDlQaoxR-pwapUClyvr-JIl8oJchp2_9tnXFhePiGLnaSRj12pHj9632H0ueDv4FAAD__zSNhGQ) as the pro-Israel group becomes politically toxic in a party that's moved sharply against Netanyahu during the Iran war.

★★★

Chicago Alderwoman Draws National Fury

Chicago Alderwoman Maria Hadden suggested Gorman was in the ["wrong place at the wrong time"](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJycULuypCAU_BrNmAJkUAOCTczuphtaRzgypy4CBYze_fst5xM26-quflT_-Vq_gAJF_xsONPak1SW3VjgRbHMIIcNPSzEguGpTWSWXmvGBSbXGsIreGev0IHs0YhzVMCmhdf8ysE84o4BR6B22adq4nZ-4jzBviu-76MncSXyQSnI5y-dj04Oahd7sc3ZOiKFT_J0dNKwPm2LFckKjEynGdKMUHzYdfTCv1nLthl-dXDq5XNf12NNPxOu2HZ1ccgrUyNZOLvZFFnxiAa4DvrGwQjmjY-nEwhxV_66NomcFa74rWUvMphDQI6vt7TA29k0hoGPbXwYfwbGb8BAYHQf5ArH1xbh8UQhU9dgp7g-g8Fnb_uPg08h_AQAA___rm5CP) and may have "startled" her killer. Gorman's family fired back, calling it a preventable act -- not a random misfortune.

Cassidy refuses to appear before conservative Louisiana voters

| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEMarch 24, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**CASSIDY DECLINES MOON GRIFFON DEBATE** _Cassidy refuses to appear before conservative Louisiana voters_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — After weeks of demanding debates, Bill Cassidy is now [declining](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=ede2ac5d5f&e=95355a072c) to participate in a debate hosted by the Moon Griffon Show, one of the most widely listened-to conservative platforms in the state.
Cassidy said, “Louisiana voters deserve a healthy debate on the issues that matter most in their lives,” and declared, “I’m ready to debate.” Yet when offered that opportunity, he declined, citing the start time and doubting voters would watch online, despite spending the past 17 days insisting debates are “a basic expectation in any serious Senate race.”
Congresswoman Julia Letlow, the Trump endorsed candidate for U.S. Senate in Louisiana, accepted the invitation and made it clear that she is ready to stand before Louisiana Republican voters.
_“Republican voters deserve the chance to hear directly from the candidates in this race,”_**said Rep. Letlow.**_“That is why I accepted this invitation. I’m proud of my record, proud to stand with President Trump, and proud to fight for conservative values. Senator Cassidy spent weeks insisting voters deserved this conversation, and now he is the one refusing to have it.”_
**Moon Griffon** sent KEEL this statement:_“Cassidy says Letlow is hiding from the Public. He came on my program for over a decade. After his guilty vote on Trump he has not come on my program for over 5years. I just wonder what he and Biden been talking about in the basement they been hiding in for all these years.”_

For more than a year, Trump has been pushing tariffs — aka taxes! — despite widespread pushback, a clear legal rebuke from the Supreme Court, and devastating impacts on our economy for both consumers and businesses.
Just a few things that are more expensive thanks to Trump’s tax hikes:
* Your iPhone
* TVs
* Cars
* Clothes and shoes
* Wine, beer, and liquor
* Furniture
* Coffee
* Chocolate
And it’s not just consumer goods that have gotten pricier — housing has been impacted by this because of our reliance on imported building materials. And I know you don’t need me to tell you that we already have a housing crisis!
I’ve talked to small businesses and families in San Diego, and they’ve all been saying the same thing for months now: We can’t afford this.
Americans across the country of all political persuasions agree:
https://secure.ngpvan.com/6HawfInAWU-Q8E03kCg-bA2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/6HawfInAWU-Q8E03kCg-bA2]
The good news is that Congress could reverse this disaster. The bad news is that the GOP majority hasn’t lifted a finger to do anything about it.
House Republicans could pass legislation to roll back the tariffs. They could hold hearings to expose the economic damage. They could push Trump to reverse course. Instead — even when they admit the tariffs are bad for their constituents — the vast majority of House Republicans have voted to protect Trump’s tariff authority. No pushback. No solutions. And they’re actively protecting Trump — it’s wild.
I refuse to let GOP economic failures go unchecked. I’m fighting for trade policies that actually work — policies that lower costs, create American jobs, strengthen supply chains, bolster American manufacturing, and keep our international alliances intact.
But with Democrats in the minority, we need to do more than just fight in Congress, and we can’t afford to wait until we flip the House in November.
Right now, we need to ramp up the public pressure.
Will you help? When enough of us raise our voices, we make it clear that we’re paying attention — and that we won’t accept these reckless policies without a fight.
📢 Sign my petition now to say NO to Trump’s illegal and ill-advised tariffs. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/6HawfInAWU-Q8E03kCg-bA2]

Thanks for speaking out,
Sara

name: David Hogg
subject: The SAVE Act is dangerous for young voters
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Here’s how this GOP-backed bill would harm young voters.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260324-1&t=1&akid=3282%2E587540%2EkBPAZr)
Peter,
College students and young people already face unique barriers when it comes to voting. Do they vote at home or where they go to college? Is there a polling location on campus? If not, do they have reliable transportation to get to the polling center? Basically, did they jump through all of the right hoops so that their vote would count?
If our leaders weren’t afraid of us, you’d think they would want to make it _easier_ for young people to vote and new voters to get involved in the electoral process. But instead, _**Republicans want to make voting even harder than it already is._**
The GOP-backed SAVE Act has already passed the House and is now in front of the Senate. The bill would nationalize elections, require proof of citizenship to register to vote, eliminate convenient methods of voter registration, and prohibit universal mail-in voting.
Several states are following up with their own versions: Florida, South Dakota, and Utah. Similar laws are on the books in Wyoming, New Hampshire, and Louisiana.
**Why is the SAVE Act downright dangerous — particularly for young people?**
**Documentation requirements hit young voters the hardest.** Requiring proof of citizenship and photo ID to vote means young people who may lack (or not have easy access to) these kinds of documents won’t be able to cast their ballots. I don’t know many kids who brought their birth certificate to college!
**Costs and logistics are functionally a poll tax for young voters.** Young people are already trying to balance school and work while often living on a limited income. It isn’t reasonable to expect them to navigate more bureaucracy, pay for new kinds of identification, and take time off of work or school so they can vote.
**Eliminating convenient registration methods primarily impacts new voters.** This one is obvious. Whenever politicians make it harder to register to vote, it is a direct attack on young people who are often voting for the first time in their lives.
_**Here’s the bottom line:_** Republicans are intent on making every step of the voting process _more complex_ and _less convenient_. And if they pass the SAVE Act, it will make the work we’re doing getting young people out to vote that much harder.
But we aren’t going to give up the fight no matter what the GOP throws at us. We know there is too much at stake to let them keep young people from voting. We are ready to fight back, but we need your continued support to ensure we have the resources to fulfill our mission in 2026 and beyond.

Thank you for standing with us.
David Hogg

Because I’m not.
Friend,
Trump is talking about bringing back the military draft.
Not as a hypothetical or last resort. Just casually floating forcing thousands of Americans to serve in a war with no clear mission and no legal authorization from Congress.
Let me make this real for you:
\- A draft means your kids, your neighbors, your community being either sent to war or to jail if they refuse.
\- There's no clear mission or sense of how (or when) this ends.
\- There's no accountability — Trump dodged the draft in Vietnam, and now he wants your kids to go fight in a war he created.
\- And there's no honest answer about why.
Look, I don’t know what goes through Donald Trump’s head. I’m not a child psychologist.
But I’ve faced the consequences of these decisions. I've led Marines in Iraq. I've looked people in the eye while they asked me why they were being sent into harm's way. That question deserves a real answer from our Commander in Chief.
If we're asking — or under a draft, demanding — Americans to risk their lives, the bare minimum our leaders can do is be honest about it and own the decision. And Democrats can't keep responding with careful, poll-tested language and hope it lands. We have to actually take this on.
That's why I'm running.
If you're with me, chip in today:

Friends,
A couple of exciting updates to report. First, we submitted more than 2,150 certified signatures from registered Maine Democrats (of 2,600+ collected) to qualify David for Maine’s Democratic primary ballot on June 9. David will be sharing the June ballot with Governor Janet Mills and Graham Platner, and aside being an alternative candidate, David will be making the case that his background, governing knowledge and experience, and substantive reform agenda makes him the most fitting candidate to defeat Senator Susan Collins in 2026.
Second, we’re happy announce that former U.S. Senate candidate Tucker Favreau has joined the Campaign as the Campaign’s campaign manager. Tucker, a West Point graduate and Army veteran has spent many months speaking with and listening to the concerns of Maine voters and has ten years of national security, cybersecurity, and digital technology experience. In a press release, David mentioned that he thought “Tucker had run an impressive, policy focused campaign for the U.S. Senate” and that “he was excited to have Tucker on board.”
Lastly, check out the Op Ed and letter to the editor below from the _Portland Press Herald_ encouraging readers to look beyond the current “political horse race” favorites and consider supporting David.
And, as always, please consider joining us in making the case for real change in Washington and supporting David’s efforts to succeed by sharing this email with others and contributing $15, or any amount that works for you, to help in ramping up our campaign activities. Tuesday, March 31, is the deadline for our next federal election’s commission (FEC) campaign finances report.
Thank you,Team Costello
**Maine Democrats: Don’t forget David Costello in Senate primary | Steve Collins**
As the battle between Janet Mills and Graham Platner grows ever more bitter, the third candidate in the race can strike a different note. The Democratic U.S. Senate candidate who hauled in 89,000 votes as his party’s nominee two years ago is today languishing in obscurity in a three-way primary for the same office. While Gov. Janet Mills and the former harbor master of a little seaside town, Graham Platner, hog the spotlight, [David Costello of Brunswick](https://costelloforsenate.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d37adbc910a9a40e00b14f5&id=3cc599b5e9&e=5d7176e969) is akin to a designated driver sipping a Diet Coke in the corner. Costello, who worked for years in government and offers a sensible liberal agenda, deserves more attention.
It’s no small feat that Platner, a 41-year-old oyster farmer and disabled combat veteran, has snatched the lead from Mills who, four years ago, racked up 376,934 votes to [steamroll Republican Paul LePage to win a second term](https://costelloforsenate.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d37adbc910a9a40e00b14f5&id=835d1a9344&e=5d7176e969) four years ago. But Platner’s thin resume and past penchant for saying nutty things on Reddit remain potential obstacles for him. Nobody doubts that Mills, 78, has the experience for the Senate after serving as a district attorney, the state attorney general and governor. Some rightly wonder about her age. Others worry she’s too moderate.
As the competition between Mills and Platner [grows ever more bitter](https://costelloforsenate.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d37adbc910a9a40e00b14f5&id=11f00eecf8&e=5d7176e969), perhaps Costello, 65, can strike a different note. In 2024, Maine Democrats tapped him as their standard bearer in a longshot race to unseat independent Sen. Angus King. To nobody’s surprise, Costello didn’t come close. Although Costello remains mired in single digits in every poll and is trailing badly in fundraising, Jim Melcher, a professor of political science at the University of Maine at Farmington, told me there’s little question he is “a serious candidate” with sufficient policy and campaign experience.
Though Costello certainly has a challenging path to victory, Melcher noted he “hasn’t had the controversies Platner has had and he’s over a decade younger than Mills.” Melcher expects Costello to influence the primary’s outcome in a [ranked-choice voting](https://costelloforsenate.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d37adbc910a9a40e00b14f5&id=b567c4004c&e=5d7176e969) race; his supporters’ second-place votes might help propel Mills or Platner over the top if there’s no first-round winner.
If voters might stop and recognize that Costello has experience and ideas worth considering, it’s possible he could do even better. As Melcher put it, if Democrats recognize the flaws in Platner and Mills, they may just decide the mild-mannered guy “hanging around trying to be the substantive alternative” may prove the most electable.
Costello recently told me that he felt Washington was broken, that Maine’s next senator needs to be able to articulate how that came to pass “and then lay out a phased approach” to fix it, or at least make it better. “We need to have more people who are just talking rationally about politics,” he said, a comment that’s both clearly true and utterly depressing. I don’t know who Democrats should vote for in the June 9 primary. But I am sure they shouldn’t simply ignore Costello. After all, he’s the only one of the trio vying for the nomination who has ever run for Senate before.

# Enough about Mills and Platner. What about Costello?
###

I just read a March 11 letter from a Maine voter who was dismayed at what he sees as a lack of choice in the Democratic primary for the U.S. Senate [(“Where are the true progressive candidates for Maine?”) .](https://costelloforsenate.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d37adbc910a9a40e00b14f5&id=fe9c824e20&e=5d7176e969) This particular voter felt neither of the frontrunners, Janet Mills or Graham Platner, offered much to voters interested in a more progressive candidate.
I decided, months ago, that neither of these candidates would get my vote. While I appreciate Mills’ service, I believe it’s time for a younger candidate; and while Platner is a young man, I am not comfortable with much of his background.
I have been impressed by what I have read about David Costello.
David is a Maine native, born in Bangor, and raised by his mother and grandparents in Old Town after the death of his father at a young age. Like many Mainers, David worked hard to pay for his education at the University of Maine, George Washington University and the London School of Economics. He has spent over 30 years in public service, in both government and non-government positions, here in the United States and throughout the word. This experience is invaluable, in my opinion, when seeking a position in the Senate.
I have never bought into the argument that we need candidates from outside the government. I feel that someone who has worked within the system knows from day one how to get the job done. I hope more voters will take a serious look at this exceptional candidate.
**Ann Pelosi**
_Westbrook_

Janet Mills and the former harbor master of a little seaside town, Graham Platner, hog the spotlight, is akin to a designated driver sipping a Diet Coke in the corner. Costello, who worked for years in government and offers a sensible liberal agenda, deserves more attention. It’s no small feat that Platner, a 41-year-old oyster farmer and disabled combat veteran, has snatched the lead from Mills who, four years ago, racked up 376,934 votes to four years ago. But Platner’s thin resume and past penchant for saying nutty things on Reddit remain potential obstacles for him. Nobody doubts that Mills, 78, has the experience for the Senate after serving as a district attorney, the state attorney general and governor. Some rightly wonder about her age. Rev. Warnock

From: Rev. Raphael Warnock
Subject: Donald Trump’s full-on assault on voting rights

Friend, Donald Trump has launched a full-on assault on voting rights.

The FBI raided the Fulton County election center here in Georgia, seizing thousands of ballots cast in the 2020 election. This is just one example of Donald Trump’s vendetta against Georgia officials and voters after he lost here in 2020.

He’s also trying to take control of our elections, calling for them to be run by the federal government. In other words, run by him. And he’s threatening to deploy ICE to polling places – using the agency as a secret police force to pursue political enemies and intimidate voters.

Donald Trump knows his support is collapsing under his historically unpopular agenda. He knows he can’t win fair and square. So he’s attacking your ability to hold him accountable.

But it won’t work. I’ve spent my whole career fighting for voting rights. I’m not about to let Donald Trump take them away, and I know you aren’t either.

If we raise our voices together, there is nothing Donald Trump can do to stop what’s coming. That’s why I’m counting on you to take action today and sign my brand-new petition to protect voting rights. Please, if you’re with me, will you add your name now to condemn Trump’s voter suppression efforts and protect the right to vote?

https://surveys.signforgood.com/warnock-voting-rights-pet-email?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&code=jtk5727-su-text

Thank you for being part of this crucial fight,

Rev. Raphael Warnock

On March 26, we mark the 81st anniversary of the end of the Battle of Iwo Jima.

Dear Faithful Friend, **Imagine this:** A man steps outside his own home in a quiet neighborhood. Suddenly, violence erupts, his kneecap shattered in a brutal attack. His car torched. His family terrorized for years, children taunted with slurs in the streets, living under police protection for nearly a decade. This isn't a scene from some distant war zone. **This happened in Bradford, England – to Nissar Hussain.** **His only "crime"? Leaving Islam and embracing Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior.** For 17 years, Nissar endured relentless persecution from his former community. The Church of England? _**SILENT.**_ Not one bishop stood with him or his family. **But Save the Persecuted Christians, where I’m proud to serve as a board member, refused to stand by. We brought Nissar here to the U.S. to help him share his story, and he is now fighting back boldly – in part by pursuing a groundbreaking legal case against 11 countries that still mandate death for apostasy. ** [**Your support has amplified his voice and his mission to expose this evil.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=092711d957e44aab90583e44bf24ec69&_e=IT5R39SYfMT-1ha57m2NQEbSTNjvkDNJahRcEmGZiRvfw-K9XBt3hPon2MIsuO7NYUDnIb0NlNK3EJHIVzAWDzKRQo0pmj0A8GwRq1XbRYiYo5Dcr1x2B666mXltr_agV1_fUeiVRRXIz4e8Rj6P5cfrZk-kn6-sMNI25RRP4-hZmeo1-mcFZvVNrJQtku0uvsgZMI28I3d5WKNYvSMkaFj5qfxjEFyoURV6Q2d03BEWpuavjCgB8B3NzlnY9g8Qe-SVCEEUlLaZ8ciRX6z8cqjAt3iuPOcRQUVl-7bjz2LMeJRGHkBGyhkQfFq2zJ38du9H-Vp_24mN5SEVNE-28cmwHVLo-0AOO4cpbAoXugPtWZhskGQ5QrVz9zZluAA_EVK1HDUr-kC_r3POfspwMaYEBYPXCQorbWCxIecZG6qWXaoll6-K9B6Hj7NOQd9cuyBdykoBfQYG6smKFi4UzY9Az7yquOjM1xnAZFoso-4pI04jREQeVmmPHHgNs25M8XMhJmbig65GuPOICMEFQPq2KTeYi5s239GvFktyoW1RhdaZ5-C31zb-XzGkSS5FufYV6UNZ4yciVcIi_mNpNz0F3C5WfngbU-uu7u87u1bog95iuJjiYXJ9joBec6ynhCIKYdeE-p3rc2xa8-H0Rbu8nyz399RAnXYEjAFh9nI8KblOoh2KE4EXmek7xj9nZgUVEHPngpuzdxfs1cNnCA%3D%3D) Nissar's story is heartbreaking, but it's not isolated. Suddenly, violence erupts, his kneecap shattered in a brutal attack. His car torched. His family terrorized for years, children taunted with slurs in the streets, living under police protection for nearly a decade. This isn't a scene from some distant war zone. This happened in Bradford, England – to Nissar Hussain. His only "crime"? Leaving Islam and embracing Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior. For 17 years, Nissar endured relentless persecution from his former community. The Church of England? SILENT. Not one bishop stood with him or his family. But Save the Persecuted Christians, where I’m proud to serve as a board member, refused to stand by. We brought Nissar here to the U.S. to help him share his story, and he is now fighting back boldly – in part by pursuing a groundbreaking legal case against 11 countries that still mandate death for apostasy. Nissar's story is heartbreaking, but it's not isolated. Over 380 million Christians face severe persecution globally, and the numbers are growing. In Iran, 254 believers were arrested in 2025 alone for simply practicing their faith, escalating further amid the regime's war on Christians. In Nigeria, thousands have been slaughtered by Islamist militants: entire villages massacred, girls held captive for years, all because they refused to deny Christ. In Pakistan, blasphemy laws are twisted to destroy Christian lives. In North Korea, owning a Bible can mean a lifetime in a labor camp. It is for all of these reasons that Save the Persecuted Christians is relentlessly educating Americans and rallying the faithful to recognize the threat before it takes deeper root here. A powerful example: Our ongoing education and advocacy efforts helped fuel the overwhelming success on March 3, when 95% of Texas Republican primary voters stood up and voted to ban Sharia law – sending a clear, faithful message: We will not let this ideology gain a foothold in America and threaten our freedoms or our persecuted brothers and sisters in Christ. But the jobs report tells a different story. The U.S. economy lost 92,000 jobs last month, unemployment is rising, and the cost of everyday essentials is still putting real pressure on families. Here in Middle Tennessee, we hear the same thing everywhere our campaign goes: 🥪 Groceries cost too much. 🏡 Rent is out of reach. 💵 Paychecks just aren’t keeping up. Yet instead of acknowledging the affordability crisis families are facing, Andy Ogles continues to pretend everything is fine. Pretending everything is fine doesn’t help the families who are feeling the squeeze every day. # Jack Smith secretly requested two years of Kash Patel's phone records
Former special counsel Jack Smith subpoenaed nearly **[two years of FBI Director Kash Patel's phone records,](https://substack.com/redirect/fe225e4f-7284-4ac0-a31f-c04d84db2a39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** including calls and texts without content, along with addresses, under secret nondisclosure orders signed by judges, documents released by Senate Judiciary Chairman Chuck Grassley revealed Tuesday.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fe225e4f-7284-4ac0-a31f-c04d84db2a39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Subpoenas Targeted Patel Data:** Smith's team requested Patel's records from October 1, 2020 to February 22, 2023 and January 1, 2021 to November 23, 2022, signed by Magistrate Judge James Mazzone and Obama appointee Judge Beryl Howell, keeping the subpoenas secret.
**Congress Members Also Targeted:** Smith sought toll records for more than a dozen Republican members of Congress including Kevin McCarthy, Ted Cruz, Lee Zeldin, Matt Gaetz and Paul Gosar, with emails showing prosecutors planned to subpoena many members' records.
**Reliance on January 6 Report:** An January 2023 briefing showed Smith's team went over the Jan. 6 committee report page by page and incorporated it into their investigative plan, though Smith later said the committee's work was only a small part of the record.
**Senators Demand More Records:** Republican Sens. Chuck Grassley and Ron Johnson criticized Smith's partisan tactics targeting Trump allies and ordinary citizens, expecting AT&T and Verizon to comply with their own subpoenas for further evidence of weaponization of the justice system.

clean_body: The Far-Left STILL wants to see lives destroyed beyond repair | | | | Peter, Imagine this: A man steps outside his own home in a quiet neighborhood. Suddenly, violence erupts, his kneecap shattered in a brutal attack. His car torched. His family terrorized for years, children taunted with slurs in the streets, living under police protection for nearly a decade. This isn't a scene from some distant war zone. This happened in Bradford, England – to Nissar Hussain. His only "crime"? Leaving Islam and embracing Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior. For 17 years, Nissar endured relentless persecution from his former community. The Church of England? SILENT. Not one bishop stood with him or his family. But Save the Persecuted Christians, where I’m proud to serve as a board member, refused to stand by. We brought Nissar here to the U.S. to help him share his story, and he is now fighting back boldly – in part by pursuing a groundbreaking legal case against 11 countries that still mandate death for apostasy. Nissar's story is heartbreaking, but it's not isolated. Over 380 million Christians face severe persecution globally, and the numbers are growing. In Iran, 254 believers were arrested in 2025 alone for simply practicing their faith, escalating further amid the regime's war on Christians. In Nigeria, thousands have been slaughtered by Islamist militants: entire villages massacred, girls held captive for years, all because they refused to deny Christ. In Pakistan, blasphemy laws are twisted to destroy Christian lives. In North Korea, owning a Bible can mean a lifetime in a labor camp. It is for all of these reasons that Save the Persecuted Christians is relentlessly educating Americans and rallying the faithful to recognize the threat before it takes deeper root here. A powerful example: Our ongoing education and advocacy efforts helped fuel the overwhelming success on March 3, when 95% of Texas Republican primary voters stood up and voted to ban Sharia law – sending a clear, faithful message: We will not let this ideology gain a foothold in America and threaten our freedoms or our persecuted brothers and sisters in Christ. The threat is real. Persecution that starts overseas doesn't always stay there. We must be extra vigilant, and we need your help right now to keep pushing back. Your gift, especially a monthly commitment through The Defenders Guild, multiplies our impact and sustains the fight against this growing evil. Paul wrote in Galatians 6:2, “Carry each other’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.” That is our mandate as the Body of Christ. The Church must rise in one spirit, refusing silence in the face of darkness. Thank you for your faithfulness and courage in this hour. In Christ, Eric Metaxas Member, Board of Directors Save the Persecuted Christians | | Paid for by Save the Persecuted Christians Save the Persecuted Christians PO Box 543 Monument, CO 80132 USA

body:
It might be easy to think New Mexico is a safe blue state, friend, but it isn’t.

| | |
---
Hi friend, it’s Deb. I wanted to reach out to you personally about what’s at stake in New Mexico’s governor’s race. If you already know what we’re up against — and how much your donation matters — then [**please, friend, chip in $5 or more right now so I can become New Mexico’s next governor, keep this state blue, and deliver for New Mexican families.**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5903?refcode=jtk450-fr-nd&t=1&akid=8469%2E400544%2EzHlLQC)
| | [CHIP IN >>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5903?refcode=jtk450-fr-nd&t=2&akid=8469%2E400544%2EzHlLQC)
---
It might be easy to think New Mexico is a safe blue state, friend, but it isn’t. The margins continue to narrow here. In 2018, our Democratic governor won by 15 points, but in 2022, that margin got cut in half. And history isn’t on our side, the governor’s office has flipped parties every eight years since the 1990s. That means Republicans are counting on 2026.
But we won’t let that happen.
While Trump has been in the White House making people sicker, hungrier, and poorer, New Mexico has been fighting for working families **all because of our Democratic governor.**
* **We are the first state to EVER pass universal childcare.** New Mexican families will now have free childcare regardless of income. When I was a single mother who volunteered at my child’s preschool for discounted tuition, this would have changed my life.

* **We supplemented SNAP benefits when Donald Trump was politicizing hunger.** I relied on programs like SNAP, WIC, and Medicaid to help keep my child fed and healthy, so I know firsthand no one should have to worry about their next meal.

* **We are the first state to bar armed federal agents from polling places.** Donald Trump knows how unpopular his extremist agenda is and is already trying to undermine elections and flip our state red. He’s even called New Mexico elections “corrupt” to sow doubt and sway our state.

Friend, none of this would have been possible without a Democratic governor, fighting for working families and to protect our fundamental rights. **But with FIVE Republicans running to bring Trump’s extremist agenda to New Mexico, the stakes couldn’t be higher.**
I am ready to strengthen education, to raise the minimum wage, to ensure you can see a doctor when you are sick, and to protect our communities from Trump’s hurtful, dangerous agenda. **I've stood up to Trump before, and won. I’ll do it again as governor.** But I need your help to get there.
[**Our most important fundraising deadline yet is just weeks away, and every donation makes a difference. It’s how we fight back, win this race, and keep New Mexico blue. So please, friend, will you chip in $5 or more right now?**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5903?refcode=jtk450-fr-nd&t=3&akid=8469%2E400544%2EzHlLQC)

What issues are you and your family talking about at the dinner table?
What is keeping you up at night?

I have been traveling across the state since we launched in October, and I have heard the same thing everywhere I go.
**Texans are tired.** Tired of Greg Abbott. Tired of the corruption. Tired of watching our schools, healthcare, and basic affordability lose priority while he plays political games just to stay in power.
That’s why I’m running, Peter — because Texans deserve so much more.
We deserve real action on rising costs in our state. We deserve access to affordable, high-quality healthcare. We deserve a well-funded education system that works for students, parents, and teachers and allows Texans to thrive.
I know we can do better, and that’s why I’m running.
**But I don’t want this campaign to just be about what I think. I want it to reflect what you need.**

Gina

name: Christopher Ahuja for Congress
subject: ICE is at the airport. That should alarm you.
body:
Don't Let Them Normalize This

| | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=31bc613024&e=53c7d12fc7)
| | | | | | Dear Peter,**ICE agents are now showing up at airports—while TSA workers have been doing their jobs without pay.** The presence of ICE agents in airports is so disruptive that flight delays as long as five hours are occurring. While ICE agents have been legally compelled to operate without masking their identities, they are also trying to hide their faces every way they can think of—including allegedly blinding reporters with flashlights.That might sound like a small shift, but it isn’t. It’s a signal — about where this is headed, and about what those in power think they can normalize if we let them.**This is how it starts**. You introduce something extreme into a space where it’s never been before, wait for people to adjust, and then push it further.**Airports today.
Polling places tomorrow**.At the same time, Congress is debating how to fund DHS. Instead of setting real conditions to protect people, they’re writing checks that expand enforcement and deepen harm. That’s a choice.We could be investing in processing cases, keeping families together, and building a system grounded in dignity. Instead, we’re funding fear.**I’m running for Congress because I’m not willing to accept that tradeoff.** We need real conditions on DHS funding that help immigrants — not target them.[**If you’re with me, help us build the kind of campaign that can actually fight back.**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=6dab2eaf8c&e=53c7d12fc7) Because once this becomes normal, it’s much harder to undo.
---

**In solidarity,**

body:

Taylor Swift.
Pearl Jam.
Olivia Dean.
Zach Bryan.
Oasis.
The Cure. What do they all have in common? Besides all being in a regular rotation on your playlists, these artists have all called out Ticketmaster for ripping off fans. And the Trump administration just sided against every single one of them and every fan who’s ever been squeezed at checkout. [**I’ll break down exactly what Trump did (and why it matters) below—and if you’re sick and tired of corporations charging you more and more for worse and worse services, chip in $28 to help our campaign keep fighting corporate monopolies like this.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3558?amount=28&t=8&akid=2829%2E4032634%2Ewlikcr)

Here’s the latest on the fight to take on Ticketmaster: Back in 2024, the Department of Justice officially filed an antitrust lawsuit against Live Nation to break up their monopoly over the live entertainment industry. The case alleged that Live Nation relies on unlawful, anticompetitive conduct to exercise its monopolistic control over the live events industry — resulting in fans paying more in fees, artists having fewer opportunities to play concerts, smaller promoters getting squeezed out, and venues having fewer real choices for ticketing services. Sounds promising, right? That the government might actually secure a win on behalf of the people? **Well, Trump just let them off the hook with the equivalent of a corporate pardon.** His DOJ just issued a penalty that came out to about 1% of Live Nation’s $25 billion in revenue last year — and they still get to tack on a 15% “Ticketmaster Tax” to your tickets. It was reported that a good buddy of Trump’s — a former Live Nation board member — called him, urging him to settle the antitrust case. That’s not accountability. It’s a green light to keep doing exactly what they’ve been doing: jacking up prices, deprioritizing building a strong product and service, tricking fans with hidden fees, and harming employees, vendors, and artists in the process. What’s more, during this lawsuit, internal messages between Live Nation employees were discovered that showed just how much pride they felt about charging fans so much money. “These people are so stupid,” one employee joked, referring to one ticket package being priced at $199. “I almost feel bad taking advantage of them.”
His co-worker replied: “I have VIP parking up to $250 lol.” “Robbing them blind baby,” the same employee wrote in another note on setting prices. “That’s how we do.” This corporate behavior is a slap in the face — and the President just excused it. We have to keep fighting back. And we need to break up Ticketmaster and Live Nation. I’m fighting hard to continue to take on concentrated corporate power like this and stop companies from getting away with ridiculously high prices and ridiculously crummy service. I’ve also got a bill — the Prohibiting Anticompetitive Mergers Act — to ban the biggest, most competition-crushing mergers, restore competition, and bring down prices for consumers. [**If you agree that we need to break up big corporate monopolies like this, please pitch in $28 or anything you can to support this work.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3558?amount=28&t=14&akid=2829%2E4032634%2Ewlikcr) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

clean_body: Every fan deserves better | | | Taylor Swift. Pearl Jam. Olivia Dean. Zach Bryan. Oasis. The Cure. What do they all have in common? Besides all being in a regular rotation on your playlists, these artists have all called out Ticketmaster for ripping off fans. And the Trump administration just sided against every single one of them and every fan who’s ever been squeezed at checkout. If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | | | | Here’s the latest on the fight to take on Ticketmaster: Back in 2024, the Department of Justice officially filed an antitrust lawsuit against Live Nation to break up their monopoly over the live entertainment industry. The case alleged that Live Nation relies on unlawful, anticompetitive conduct to exercise its monopolistic control over the live events industry — resulting in fans paying more in fees, artists having fewer opportunities to play concerts, smaller promoters getting squeezed out, and venues having fewer real choices for ticketing services. Sounds promising, right? That the government might actually secure a win on behalf of the people? Well, Trump just let them off the hook with the equivalent of a corporate pardon. His DOJ just issued a penalty that came out to about 1% of Live Nation’s $25 billion in revenue last year — and they still get to tack on a 15% “Ticketmaster Tax” to your tickets. It was reported that a good buddy of Trump’s — a former Live Nation board member — called him, urging him to settle the antitrust case. That’s not accountability. It’s a green light to keep doing exactly what they’ve been doing: jacking up prices, deprioritizing building a strong product and service, tricking fans with hidden fees, and harming employees, vendors, and artists in the process. What’s more, during this lawsuit, internal messages between Live Nation employees were discovered that showed just how much pride they felt about charging fans so much money. “These people are so stupid,” one employee joked, referring to one ticket package being priced at $199. “I almost feel bad taking advantage of them.” His co-worker replied: “I have VIP parking up to $250 lol.” “Robbing them blind baby,” the same employee wrote in another note on setting prices. “That’s how we do.” This corporate behavior is a slap in the face — and the President just excused it. We have to keep fighting back. And we need to break up Ticketmaster and Live Nation. I’m fighting hard to continue to take on concentrated corporate power like this and stop companies from getting away with ridiculously high prices and ridiculously crummy service. I’ve also got a bill — the Prohibiting Anticompetitive Mergers Act — to ban the biggest, most competition-crushing mergers, restore competition, and bring down prices for consumers. clean_body: - Michele Tafoya here! I never really considered running for office. Ever. I was too focused on raising my family, and being the best football sideline reporter I could be. But even in the last few weeks, Minnesota has become the embodiment of everything wrong with politics today. Tim Walz, his inner circle, and the corrupt political class are too busy: Wasting billions of our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares Failing to condemn the activists storming churches Raising prices on hardworking families Sabotaging anything the President wants to do Forcing men into women's spaces Pitting Americans against each other I can 't sit on the sidelines anymore. That's why I'm throwing my hat in the ring and announcing my candidacy for U.S. Senate! thought long and hard about the dynamics of this race before jumping in. Minnesota has long been considered simply out of reach for Republicans. The last time it voted for a GOP President was Nixon. The pundits and political experts say a Republican could never win here. But this year is going to be different for three key reasons: FIRST - I'm running against Tim Walz's right hand. All the rampant fraud that took place here happened under Peggy Flanagan's nose as much as it did under his. We will remind voters about that fact every single day. SECOND - The President has increased his voter share each time he has run. He nearly flipped this state in the last election, and Kamala Harris' running mate was our sitting Governor! Momentum is on our side. THIRD - I'm a different kind of candidate, and I know how to win. I didn't reach the top of my industry by pulling my punches. I put in the work. I never backed down. And I kept fighting, no matter what the naysayers said. In my years on the sidelines, I 've seen a LOT of underdogs win football games that the "experts" said were impossible. The Minnesota Senate race will be another chapter in that storied history. | | ---|--- Thanks in advance for your support. name: Eric Holder, Chairman of the National Democratic Redistricting Committee
subject: Can I call on you to help protect fair elections in Virginia?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Virginians for Fair Elections
body:
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260324-379&t=1&akid=379%2E12592%2E0A6dbu)
[](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260324_1.qZHmgY&amount=3&refcode=20260324-379&t=2&akid=379%2E12592%2E0A6dbu)
_Photo Credit: Covington & Burling LLP_
Hi, it’s Eric Holder. As the Chairman of the National Democratic Redistricting Committee (NDRC), the fight unfolding in Virginia is something I’m keeping a close eye on. It is absolutely critical that the continuing effort by Trump and MAGA Republicans to unfairly rig the midterm elections through an unprecedented series of mid-decade gerrymanders is met _directly and decisively_.
[**If you already know why Virginia needs to vote YES on Fair Elections by April 21, please make a donation to Virginians For Fair Elections today. Then keep reading about why your help is so important.**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260324_1.qZHmgY&amount=3&refcode=20260324-379&t=3&akid=379%2E12592%2E0A6dbu)
**The threat to our democratic system is grave and extremely urgent.** When Trump tries to redraw maps in the middle of the decade to secure a partisan advantage, he is directly distorting representation and weakening the foundational principle that voters choose their leaders, _not the other way around_.
Protecting our democracy requires action that is serious and meets the moment. **That is why the proposed redistricting amendment in Virginia is so important.**
Virginia lawmakers have chosen a different path and are treating this moment with all the urgency it demands.
Instead of engineering backroom deals, they are pursuing a transparent process that allows voters to weigh in. They are placing trust where it belongs: with the voters.
This approach offers a clear contrast to the illegitimate power grabs engineered in Texas and the anti-democratic efforts now underway in Florida. **At a time when manipulation of the redistricting process is spreading, Virginia has the opportunity to reaffirm a basic truth: fair representation is not a partisan principle. It is an American one.**
Virginians for Fair Elections is leading the effort to ensure voters understand what is at stake. This work includes educating communities, countering misinformation, and building the grassroots infrastructure necessary to secure victory at the ballot box.
_None of this happens without resources._
If you believe that election outcomes should be earned, not engineered, I urge you to support this effort today. Your contribution will help protect transparency, accountability, and the integrity of our democratic process.
[**That’s why I’m personally asking you, please, make a contribution to Virginians for Fair Elections today.**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260324_1.qZHmgY&amount=3&refcode=20260324-379&t=4&akid=379%2E12592%2E0A6dbu)
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260324_1.qZHmgY&amount=3&refcode=20260324-379&t=23&akid=379%2E12592%2E0A6dbu)**
Our democracy depends on citizens who are willing to act when it matters most.
Sincerely,
Eric H. Holder, Jr.
Chairman, National Democratic Redistricting Committee
82nd United States Attorney General

| | Peter ,

If you care about the Second Amendment, this one’s for you.The National Firearms Act was passed in 1934. For nearly a century, it’s been used to regulate, restrict, and criminalize law-abiding gun owners. It created a federal registry. It imposed a $200 tax stamp on certain firearms. It turned Americans into paperwork criminals for exercising a constitutional right.We already scored a major victory when we eliminated the $200 tax stamp. That was a fight, and we won it. But the rest of the NFA is still on the books, and as long as it is, the federal government has a framework to keep chipping away at your rights.That’s why I’m working to repeal the National Firearms Act entirely.Not amend it. Not reform it. Repeal it.The Second Amendment doesn’t say “the right of the people to keep and bear arms, with a permission slip from the ATF.” It says “shall not be infringed.” I take those words seriously, and I think you do too.This bill won’t pass without a fight. The gun control lobby has spent decades defending the NFA as “common sense.” They’ll say the same thing they always say, that this is dangerous, that it’s extreme. But what’s extreme is a government that treats its own citizens like criminals for owning a firearm.I wanted you to know firsthand what we’re up against.For Missouri,

Let's talk about our trauma. You and me.
**January 6, 2021.**
The ripples from that day still threaten our democracy.
To this day, when I speak out about these challenges to our democracy, I get the same threatening messages. "We know where you live."
The only difference between your January 6th trauma and mine is where we were when we experienced it.
I was at the Capitol immersed in a profane mix of sweat, screams, shrieks, anger, fear, blood, death, broken limbs, spit, hatred, horror, racism, bigotry, and heroism.
Capitol and Washington Police officers fought for our lives, the lives of fellow police officers, and the nation's elected leaders. It didn't matter if they were a Republican, Democrat, or an Independent. They were the men and women we sent to Washington to govern our nation.
It was my duty to protect them and our democracy.
All the while, Donald Trump incited the violence against us and said nothing for hours. We were beaten bloody. And some died.
Even though my experience looks different from yours, I am first an American citizen. A girl dad. A football lover. A voter. This is my country - our country.
That day was a stain on our nation. And we need to fight like hell to make sure we NEVER repeat a day like that. I'll continue to use my voice to protect this country. I'll stand up to the lies, hate, and bigotry. I will always stand my ground to make sure democracy exists.
**[So I'm asking you to stand with me. We will get through this trauma -- we will get through this nightmare -- but only if we stand together and end Trump's hold on power. Can I count on you to contribute to my campaign for Congress in Maryland's 5th District?](https://substack.com/redirect/04312273-e17c-4bf8-bca0-99d1c11b2d9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[STOP THE NIGHTMARE](https://substack.com/redirect/04312273-e17c-4bf8-bca0-99d1c11b2d9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**I refuse to let** _**anyone**_**water down what happened that day.**
It's sickening that as many of us live with the trauma from that day, pardoned January 6 insurrectionists are in our government and even shaping policy at the Department of Justice.
That's why I recently testified in front of the Maryland Senate committee to support a bill that would ban Trump's rioters from serving in prestigious state government positions.
Insurrectionists belong in prison, not in the halls of power. The very people who tried to destroy our government should _not_ be running it.
**[Let's commit to standing together today and holding Trump and his cronies accountable. Please donate to my campaign for Congress today to fight for our democracy.](https://substack.com/redirect/04312273-e17c-4bf8-bca0-99d1c11b2d9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Together,
Harry

The rights we fought so hard for are under attack. | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYE5U9NTRbOMLNsSMiwuHsSrn4JnyYtk1EREaCYHldIw2Es-lCsKe-k7RYeRErCjUmpL6YWg0aqprxBCSlqaUKjL6uf8EDq6vQVEaFZEFWaTvOKtPnFc2PEalY2SnM4_7SG_NV1pXJ6v1VF5Hhch1Ks8e7XxGJzD5Ydr_d59uTU7_59CsogcyLREfSq3A3osyLkxQeaq_IbMfaqhV5zpZKJxHVWyk-y_1b-TP8oBDkyH/4p7/Rf5XT_pvRl2ewsq2-uFLXw/h0/h001.bJY_TCaZfW9Fgj-AaacrXZefihnqSp5-h4qTwAvGp28)

Hi Peter, It's Courtney Hunt. I want to talk about Women's History Month, but not the version with the inspirational quotes and the social media graphics. Real talk about the gains we've made over the last 100 years now being dismantled before our eyes - and how we stop it. I was on a panel recently and someone asked why we should celebrate women's contributions not just in March but all year long. My colleagues gave great answers - all about the progress women have made. The trailblazers who came before us and the importance of keeping that momentum going all year long. All true. All worth saying. But right now my answer is a lot more simple than that. **We celebrate because if we stop, the extremists win.** Women have spent 100 years clawing back rights that should have always been ours. Equal pay. Equal standing. The right to vote. The ability to make our own healthcare decisions without a politician inserting himself into the exam room. **And this administration has made it very clear that every single one of those gains is on the table.** [**If that matters to you too, help us flip this seat. A woman's body is not a policy debate and her healthcare decisions are not a politician's to make. Evan believes that and will fight for it and we need that in Congress right now.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8zze-UMGNobtOzWiE7K_WFBPKgn_4iuI0NbhmboRcj3L9wSCZr1ywfq-tlf1d6kGxvvw8_UiGQcCBV0jL7grpIcZCammjqIvVHjSQrWDay_iEIzU26Xl1Qeht-9I_gFetqIYN_YHxCjCG_Kpyiy0ZJtAF1ezlXEjODObDuAvDDc4QybuUNf8_ybt8ZQ7BAhjUDtYNJ4tUKkBMElMwgLSypg9EIRaV9FntoV7fqxrMKrsWhL2KzUoQlZ4VyPK_AI16u52mTOr5wThd1sMMyqpGkc/4p7/Rf5XT_pvRl2ewsq2-uFLXw/h1/h001.2n6uw0m8EsB3VYC41bohg12r7Lt3qAIHIghZ1bn_MpI) My mom raised me to never take our hard-won rights for granted. When I was 12 years old, I went with her to D.C. to fight for a woman's right to choose.

I used Planned Parenthood in my 20's when I was between jobs. I had a pre-existing condition, and I had nowhere else to go for basic healthcare. Planned Parenthood was there for me, just as they are there for millions of women every year. **I am going to fight like hell to make sure it is still there for women ten, twenty, a hundred years from now.** Because here is what is actually happening in Texas. Migrant girls as young as 13, most of them pregnant because of rape, are being moved to a detention facility in south Texas specifically to place them under the jurisdiction of our state's extreme abortion ban to prevent them from terminating a pregnancy. **If that does not make you physically sick then I do not know what will.** Keith Self will call himself pro-life while voting to gut Medicaid, cut school lunch programs, and strip away every resource a woman would need to actually raise a child his policies are forcing her to have. He and his MAGA party have built their entire political identity around a Christian nationalist agenda that treats women as vessels and calls it virtue. They have never once had to live with the consequences of a single vote they have cast. Let's change that. clean_body: The rights we fought so hard for are under attack. | | Hi Peter, It's Courtney Hunt. I want to talk about Women's History Month, but not the version with the inspirational quotes and the social media graphics. Real talk about the gains we've made over the last 100 years now being dismantled before our eyes - and how we stop it. I was on a panel recently and someone asked why we should celebrate women's contributions not just in March but all year long. My colleagues gave great answers - all about the progress women have made. The trailblazers who came before us and the importance of keeping that momentum going all year long. All true. All worth saying. But right now my answer is a lot more simple than that. We celebrate because if we stop, the extremists win. Women have spent 100 years clawing back rights that should have always been ours. Equal pay. Equal standing. The right to vote. The ability to make our own healthcare decisions without a politician inserting himself into the exam room. And this administration has made it very clear that every single one of those gains is on the table. My mom raised me to never take our hard-won rights for granted. When I was 12 years old, I went with her to D.C. to fight for a woman's right to choose. | I used Planned Parenthood in my 20's when I was between jobs. I had a pre-existing condition, and I had nowhere else to go for basic healthcare. Planned Parenthood was there for me, just as they are there for millions of women every year. I am going to fight like hell to make sure it is still there for women ten, twenty, a hundred years from now. Because here is what is actually happening in Texas. Migrant girls as young as 13, most of them pregnant because of rape, are being moved to a detention facility in south Texas specifically to place them under the jurisdiction of our state's extreme abortion ban to prevent them from terminating a pregnancy. If that does not make you physically sick then I do not know what will. Keith Self will call himself pro-life while voting to gut Medicaid, cut school lunch programs, and strip away every resource a woman would need to actually raise a child his policies are forcing her to have. He and his MAGA party have built their entire political identity around a Christian nationalist agenda that treats women as vessels and calls it virtue. They have never once had to live with the consequences of a single vote they have cast. Let's change that. Courtney Hunt | | | Evan Hunt is a combat aviator and veteran, a community and business leader, and a Texas family man, running against MAGA Rep. Keith Self in TX-03. We need all hands on deck to flip this seat. We can take back the House this year and begin to put a stop to this madness. We can restore some accountability. We can put real checks on this administration. But only if we work our asses off between now and November. = = The votes to fund TSA have been there since before this shutdown even started. And Dems have been trying for weeks to get it done. But too many Republicans would rather stay silent and go along to get along with Trump’s chaos than do the right thing. So while TSA workers are left without pay and travelers are left dealing with the fallout, ICE keeps operating out of a massive slush fund. Trump’s paramilitary army of ICE agents does not belong in our airports and is not properly trained to do this work. That’s why I’ve stepped up and said directly to my Republican colleagues: stop submitting to the whims of this out of control President. You are risking our national security by your silence and complicity. YOU can put an end to this. Say something. Fund TSA. For the sake of our country, show some damn courage! That’s how I feel. But here’s the other truth: outrage is not enough on its own. Not anymore. Not in this moment. We need sustained, grassroots power. We need to be able to respond quickly, communicate clearly, and keep building the kind of pressure that forces people to act. That takes resources. It just does. = I know people are tired. I know many of you are scared, angry, overwhelmed — yes, all at once. I feel that too. But I also know this... the answer to manufactured chaos is not surrender. It’s courage. It’s clarity. It’s showing up for each other and refusing to let the people in power bully this country into accepting the unacceptable. That’s the kind of fight I’m in. And if you’re with me, I’m asking you to support it today. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: ICE out of our airports. Now.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Republicans won’t pay TSA workers, but they’ll send lawless ICE agents in to intimidate travelers. This can’t go on another day.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260324-6046-footer&t=1&akid=6046%2E420207%2EHulu9o)
Peter,
Right now, armed ICE agents in tactical vests are roaming through terminals of the busiest airports across the country.
This is _not_ normal. And I want you to understand exactly how we got here.
Trump’s Republicans have spent six long weeks refusing to pay TSA workers. _Six weeks._ Over 400 TSA officers have quit, and thousands more are calling out because they can’t afford their basic necessities like gas, childcare, and rent while their pay is on pause. Security lines are stretching out of airport doors across the country, and wait times are as high as six hours.
Trump’s solution? Send in his lawless ICE agents to cause further chaos.
Let me be clear: ICE agents are not trained in airport security. They are not TSA officers — they’re Trump’s rogue force who have already shown this country exactly how dangerous they are. They’ve kidnapped immigrants and killed Americans in the street right before our eyes.
They have no business being in our airports.
And here’s what really makes me furious: **Democrats are ready to fund TSA**. We’ve made every effort to get those workers paid and our airports back to normal, but Republicans have blocked us from doing so _seven times_. They want to use this crisis as an excuse to hand ICE a blank check with zero accountability.
Even more outrageous than that? Steve Bannon, Trump’s own former strategist, just called the airport deployment a “test run” for placing ICE agents at polling places during our elections.
**Read that again, Peter. They’re not just using our airports as political playgrounds; they’re rehearsing for voter intimidation.**
This is what lawlessness and unchecked power look like.
I’m not going to let this go down without a fight — and I need you standing with me.
[**Will you add your name to this petition to demand that ICE get out of our airports _right now_ , and Republicans stop blocking TSA funding? We can’t let this intimidation go on another day. **](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20260324-ice-in-airports/?source=em20260324-6046&t=2&akid=6046%2E420207%2EHulu9o)

In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal
